jobs.title: Praktikum im Bereich Prädiktive Regelung von Heim-Energiemanagementsystemen
jobs.description:
Bei Bosch gestalten wir Zukunft mit hochwertigen Technologien und Dienstleistungen, die Begeisterung wecken und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Willkommen bei Bosch.

Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf deine Bewerbung!

Bist du bereit für die smarte Energiezukunft? Heim-Energiemanagementsysteme (HEMS) gestalten den Energiebedarf im Gebäude flexibler – durch die intelligente Kopplung von Komponenten wie Wärmepumpen, thermischen und elektrischen Speichern, Haushaltsgeräten sowie Elektrofahrzeugen. Mithilfe prädiktiver Regelungsalgorithmen (z. B. MPC) und datenbasierter Prognosen werden lokale Erzeugung, dynamische Stromtarife, Speicherflexibilitäten und Komfortanforderungen simultan optimiert.

- Du erweiterst bestehende Regelungsalgorithmen und entwickelst simulationsbasierte Systemmodelle kontinuierlich weiter, um die Effizienz unserer Energiesysteme zu steigern.

- Praxistaugliche und echtzeitfähige Algorithmen zur prädiktiven Regelung von Heim-Energiemanagementsystemen implementierst du eigenverantwortlich und bringst sie zur Anwendungsreife.

- Die Performance der entwickelten Algorithmen bewertest du umfassend im Rahmen verschiedener Simulationsstudien und leitest daraus gezielt Optimierungspotenziale ab.

- Eigenständig führst du Literaturrecherchen durch, um den aktuellen Stand der Technik im Bereich prädiktiver Regelungs-, Modellierungs- und Optimierungsverfahren für HEMS zu erfassen und in unsere Entwicklung einzubringen.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Ausbildung: Masterstudium im Bereich Maschienenbau, Kybernetik, Energietechnik, Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbar mit guten Studienleistungen

- Erfahrungen und Know-how: Programmierkenntnisse in Python, Kenntnisse in modellprädiktiver Regelung, idealerweise Erfahrungen mit Matlab/Simulink

- Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: du bringst proaktiv eigene Ideen ein und bereicherst unser Team durch eine offene und kollaborative Zusammenarbeit

- Arbeitsalltag: wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten

- Sprachen: verhandlungssicheres Englisch und sehr gutes Deutsch

Bosch Rexroth is one of the world’s leading providers of drive and control technologies. Regardless of the motion task that customers face anywhere in the world, they will always find a Bosch Rexroth team with the local experience and the appropriate know-how from more than 30 industries and all drive and control technologies. Our associates take on their customers’ challenges with passion and persistence until the right solution is found. This is what makes Bosch Rexroth a strong, reliable partner for Mobile Applications, Machinery Applications and Engineering and Factory Automation. As the Drive & Control Company, we develop, produce, and distribute our components and system solutions in over 80 countries.

As a Senior Cycle Counter, you will be a cornerstone of the plant’s inventory control function and a key driver in our mission to achieve best-in-class inventory accuracy. You are a proactive, hands-on expert responsible for not only executing complex cycle counts but also for investigating, analyzing, and resolving the root causes of inventory discrepancies.

Your primary mission is to significantly improve our inventory accuracy, which is currently a critical challenge with a discrepancy rate of 40%. By identifying systemic process gaps and ensuring our physical inventory aligns with SAP S/4HANA records, you will directly contribute to strengthening our internal controls, reducing financial losses, and improving operational efficiency. This role is crucial for ensuring our financial and operational processes are fully aligned with global Bosch standards for accuracy and compliance in direct coordination with the Plant management and the Finance department.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead Root-Cause Analysis & Investigation (60%):

o Lead detailed, second-level investigations into inventory discrepancies identified during cycle counts.

o Perform comprehensive root-cause analysis by auditing transaction histories in SAP (e.g., goods receipts, production postings, scrap movements) to identify process breakdowns.

o Partner with Materials Management, Receiving, Production, and Shipping to resolve systemic errors that lead to physical-to-system imbalances.

o Work with IT support staff to clear up queue issues where items get stuck and help get MM and WM inventories to sync.

o Document findings and present clear, actionable recommendations to the Inventory Supervisor to prevent recurrence.

· Execute Advanced Cycle Counting & Audits (30%):

o Conduct daily, scheduled, and ad-hoc cycle counts for high-value (Category A), critical, or complex inventory items, including raw materials, WIP, and finished goods.

o Perform process audits to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs) for material handling and system transactions on the shop floor.

o Ensure all count data is entered into SAP S/4HANA with exceptional accuracy and timeliness, serving as the final verifier for count integrity.

· Drive Process Improvement & Team Mentorship (10%):

o Continuously analyze and identify opportunities to streamline counting procedures, improve warehouse organization, and enhance inventory transaction accuracy.

o Provide expert guidance, training, and daily support to Cycle Counter I and II team members, acting as the subject matter expert for counting best practices and SAP procedures.

o Serve as the on-site specialist for inventory control processes, acting as the first point of contact for troubleshooting complex counting and system-related issues.
jobs.requirements_raw:

o Practical knowledge of SAP (MM/IM/WM modules) or a similar ERP system, with a strong understanding of inventory transactions.

o Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis and provide data-driven recommendations.

o Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to train and mentor junior team members.

o Able to speak and understand Spanish

· Education:

o High school diploma or equivalent is required.

o Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field is a plus.

jobs.description:
Let’s turn visions into reality. At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our areas of activity are every bit as diverse as our outstanding Bosch-teams around the world. Their creativity is the key to innovation through connected living, mobility or industry. Our responsibility goes far beyond ‘business’. We’re independent of stock markets and bound to the purpose of the Robert Bosch Foundation; our success directly benefits society, the environment, and future generations. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference.

Let’s be remarkable!

Welcome to a place where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch.

What will you be responsible for?

You will join the Engineering team in Turin, supporting the application, calibration, validation, and performance optimization of specific powertrain control functions in real-world environments.

- You will calibrate powertrain control functions on the RB control unit, ensuring the delivery of validated software subsets in line with project timelines and quality requirements.

- You will support the development and efficiency improvement of calibration activities, including the training and application of AI models.

- You will provide first-line technical support for issues identified during field tests, test-bench activities, vehicle testing, and customer fleet operations.

- You will act as a technical interface between internal development teams, project stakeholders, and customers for the assigned functions.

- You will perform diagnostic and validation activities and support OEM-related integration tasks.

- You will contribute to the analysis of technical issues, definition of corrective actions, and continuous improvement of calibration and application processes.

- You will work in an international and cross-functional environment, combining software, calibration, vehicle, and customer-related activities.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What distinguishes you?

Education: Master’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline, with a strong interest in the automotive industry.

Technical skills: You have a good understanding of combustion engines and powertrain systems. You have intermediate programming skills and an interest in AI model training and data-driven applications; knowledge of Python is preferred.

Experience: Previous exposure to calibration, control functions, diagnostics, software application, test-bench activities, or vehicle testing is considered a plus.

Working approach: You are results-oriented, quality-conscious, and able to approach technical topics in a structured and analytical way. You are motivated to continuously learn and improve.

Personality: You are proactive, organized, and a clear communicator. You enjoy hands-on technical work and feel comfortable working on test benches and vehicles, as well as interacting with internal stakeholders and customers.

Languages: Good command of English; knowledge of Italian is strongly preferred.

Availability: You are willing to travel for business purposes, approximately 30% of the time.

In line with our compensation policies, the gross annual salary (RAL) for this position lies within the range € 30.000 - €40.000 for a 40-hour work week.

The remuneration package also includes:

-
An individual performance-related bonus

-
Additional benefits.

We look forward to discussing the full details of our compensation package and career development opportunities with you during the application process.

jobs.description:
Discover Bosch in Blaj

Bosch, a true force for innovation and excellence, stands out as a giant of turning vision into reality. The Bosch location in Blaj has been operating since 2007, being the first production unit opened by the Bosch Group in Romania. The road to excellence was initiated in Blaj in the industrial technology sector, later consolidating in the production of sensors and electronic components for the automotive sector.

Starting 2025, the Bosch operations in Blaj are structured under two distinct legal entities: Bosch Automotive SRL and Bosch Rexroth SRL, each specializing in different technological domains.

Bosch Automotive SRL focuses on the production of sensors and transmission control components for the automotive industry, reinforcing Bosch’s commitment to smart, diversified, and sustainable powertrain solutions. The Blaj plant, active in the automotive sector since 2013, plays a vital role in developing cutting-edge technologies that support the mobility of the future. Through continuous investment in innovation and quality, Bosch Automotive in Blaj strengthens its position as a key supplier in the global automotive market.

Since 2007 Bosch Rexroth SRL specializes in industrial technology, focusing on linear motion systems and hydraulic components. The Rexroth entity in Blaj also operates a sales division, providing customized solutions and expert support to industrial customers. The ongoing investment in development and performance reinforces Bosch Rexroth’s role as a vital partner in the global industrial sector.

With a strong focus on innovation, efficiency, and sustainability, Bosch in Blaj continues to grow, offering employees professional development opportunities and fostering a collaborative and inspiring work environment. Whether in automotive technology or industrial technology and automation, Bosch in Blaj remains a pillar of excellence, shaping the future of mobility and industry.

#WorkLikeABosch!

Launched in 2021, Student Smart Career program is created to support the best young talents from our partner universities, to continue their studies, but also to gather experience in an international working environment.

Students will receive a private scholarship provided by the company during the academic year, while during summer they will join the company as working student. After finishing the second year of the program (2026-2027), they have the possibility to receive a Working Student or a full-time position in Bosch Blaj.

jobs.title: Internship in Solid Oxide Cell Development
jobs.description:
At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference.

The Robert Bosch GmbH is looking forward to your application!

A key challenge on the path to climate neutrality is storing power generated by renewable sources, for example in the form of hydrogen. Operating the solid oxide cell (SOC) in electrolysis mode as a solid oxide electrolysis cell (SOEC) enables the direct conversion of electrical energy into chemical energy. Due to its operating temperature of 600 °C and above, the SOEC has the highest electrical efficiency among electrolysis technologies, making it a very promising technology for the hydrogen economy of the future. To improve our understanding of processes occurring during SOEC operation, the cells are experimentally characterized to determine their performance and to provide data for parameterizing or validating physical models that predict cell performance or aging.

- During your internship, you will experimentally characterize SOEC single cells using electrochemical techniques, such as electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and current-voltage characteristics.

- You will support the commissioning of a new test bench, encompassing its initial operation, from software to hardware components, including high-precision measurement devices.

- Last but not least, you will evaluate experimental data and present the results to an interdisciplinary team.

jobs.title: Kickstart din marketingkarriere: Bliv en del af fremtidens industri hos Bosch Rexroth
jobs.description:
Hvad hvis dit studiejob ikke bare gav dig løn og fleksibilitet, men rent faktisk gjorde dig klar til dit første fuldtidsjob som marketingprofil, allerede før du er færdiguddannet?

Selvom Bosch Rexroth udvikler avanceret industri- og automationsteknologi, er vores arbejdsmiljø uformelt, hyggeligt og præget af hjælpsomhed. Vi har netop indviet vores helt nye kontorbygning sammen med resten af Bosch-koncernen i Ballerup. Vi er ca. 70 medarbejdere i Bosch Rexroth Danmark, som er fordelt på hovedkontoret i Ballerup samt vores salgskontor i Randers. Vi opererer med et åbent kontormiljø, hvor der er mulighed for at snakke med medarbejdere fra forskellige afdelinger. Vi er en international virksomhed der opererer i et internationalt miljø, hvor der er fokus på, at der er plads til alle.

Hos Bosch Rexroth i Ballerup søger vi en nysgerrig studentermedhjælper til vores marketingteam. Vi leder ikke efter en, der allerede kan det hele på forhånd. Vi leder efter en, der har lyst til at lære, udfordre status quo og se konkrete resultater af sine idéer hos en global teknologileder.

Hos Bosch Rexroth ser vi et studiejob som en gensidig investering i vores studentermedhjælpere.

Vi tilbyder bl.a.:

- En reel stejl læringskurve (og guld på dit CV): Du vil ikke blive sat til rutinemæssigt forefaldende arbejde. Du kommer bag kulisserne i moderne B2B-marketing og opbygger praktisk erfaring med content marketing, digitale kampagner, branding og events i et globalt setup.

- Fuld fleksibilitet med dit studie i centrum: Eksamensperioder og afleveringer kommer altid i første række. Vi planlægger arbejdstiden fleksibelt (gennemsnitligt ca. 15 timer om ugen), så du aldrig skal vælge mellem gode karakterer og dit studiejob.

- Mentorordning og reel sparring: Du arbejder tæt sammen med din manager, som er erfaren i marketing- og kommunikation, og som prioriterer din faglige udvikling, giver løbende feedback og lytter aktivt til dine input.

- En stærk global platform: Vi er er en af verdens mest anerkendte arbejdspladser for teknologi og innovation. Erfaring herfra åbner døre for din fremtidige karriere – både i Danmark og internationalt.

Hvad du vil opnå hos os

I stedet for en lang tjekliste over erfaringer, definerer vi succes ud fra, hvad du lærer og udretter sammen med os over tid:

- Din sprøde start: Du lærer vores brand, produkter, nøgleværktøjer og kolleger at kende. Du udarbejder dine første SoMe-opslag og får styr på vores kanaler.

- Når du føler dig klar, får du ejerskab over egne opgaver: Du driver selvstændigt koordinering af content til vores kanaler (f.eks. LinkedIn, nyhedsbreve og hjemmeside) og bidrager aktivt med kreative idéer til, hvordan vi gør tekniske emner engagerende.

- I længden er du med på værdiskabende projekter: Du er medansvarlig for planlægning og afvikling af kundearrangementer, webinarer eller messedeltagelse, og du analyserer data på vores digitale aktiviteter for at optimere fremtidige tiltag.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Hvem leder vi efter?

Vi tror på, at potentiale, nysgerrighed og drive slår mange års erfaring:

- Din uddannelse: Du er i gang med en relevant videregående uddannelse (f.eks. inden for markedsføring, kommunikation, erhvervsøkonomi eller digital formidling og har gerne 1-2 år tilbage af dit studie.

- Din motivation: Du brænder for kommunikation og marketing og har en naturlig nysgerrighed på, hvordan teknologi kan formidles fængende.

- Dine sprog- og formidlingsevner: Du skriver og taler ubesværet på dansk og begår dig godt på engelsk.

- Din tilgang: Du er initiativrig, tør stille spørgsmål og trives i et miljø, hvor man hjælper hinanden i mål.

jobs.title: [BD] Senior Automation Test Lead - AI Global Product
jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

🚀 Senior Automation Test Lead / Quality Engineering Lead ( AI Global Product )

AI Global Product | AI-Native Workflow Platform | NCLC + Agentic AI | 500,000 Users Worldwide

🌍 Engineer Quality for the Future of Intelligent Workflows

Our Global Product & Service Team is building a next-generation workflow and approval platform serving nearly 500,000 users and approximately 1,000 internal customers worldwide.

Built on OutSystems Low-Code/No-Code and evolving into an AI-native platform powered by automation, GenAI, and Agentic AI, it supports mission-critical business processes across a global corporation.

This is not a short-term testing assignment. It is a long-term product transformation where quality engineering, intelligent automation, reliability, and customer trust are critical to success.

We are looking for a Senior Test Lead who combines:

- Strong hands-on automation expertise

- Strategic quality leadership

- Team coaching and capability development

- Product and customer mindset

- Practical application of AI in testing

This is not only about finding defects.

It is about engineering quality into a global AI product from requirements to production.

✨ Why This Opportunity

Few testing roles offer the chance to shape a global enterprise product used by nearly half a million people.

You will influence:

- Product quality, reliability, and production stability

- Automation coverage and testing efficiency

- Release confidence and delivery speed

- Customer satisfaction and platform trust

- AI-enabled Quality Engineering across global Agile teams

If you want to move beyond traditional QA and help define how an AI-native product is tested, released, and continuously improved, this role is for you.

🎯 Your Mission

Lead and continuously improve the end-to-end Quality Engineering strategy for our global workflow platform.

The role combines approximately:

- 70% hands-on quality engineering, automation, and test strategy

- 30% team leadership, coaching, and capability development

You will collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, developers, architects, DevOps, operations, and global stakeholders to make quality a shared product responsibility.

🧠 Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Strategy and Ownership

- Own and improve the end-to-end test and Quality Engineering strategy

- Establish risk-based testing, quality gates, release criteria, and measurable quality standards

- Ensure coverage across functional, API, integration, regression, performance, security, accessibility, and production validation

- Drive shift-left and shift-right quality practices

- Provide evidence-based release readiness and go/no-go recommendations

- Track KPIs including automation coverage, defect leakage, regression duration, test stability, and release confidence

2. Hands-On Automation Engineering

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Playwright with Python

- Build reliable automated tests for web applications, APIs, integrations, workflows, and critical business journeys

- Perform manual and exploratory testing where automation is insufficient

- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines

- Improve test reusability, reporting, data management, maintainability, and execution speed

- Reduce flaky tests and establish automation coding and review standards

3. Requirements and Product Testability

- Review requirements, designs, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria

- Challenge ambiguity and identify risks, dependencies, edge cases, and negative scenarios early

- Improve testability, traceability, and Definition of Ready with Product Owners and Business Analysts

- Promote quality-by-design rather than testing only at the end of delivery

4. Integration and Non-Functional Quality

- Strengthen testing for APIs, integrations, business rules, permissions, and approval workflows

- Plan and execute performance, load, stress, scalability, resilience, and recovery testing

- Collaborate with Architecture, DevOps, Security, and Operations to ensure global platform reliability

5. AI-Driven Quality Engineering

- Apply AI across requirement analysis, test design, test data, automation, defect analysis, and regression optimization

- Explore Agentic AI for intelligent test generation, execution, monitoring, and continuous learning

- Ensure human review, traceability, security, and governance of AI-generated testing assets

- Measure AI value through improved coverage, productivity, defect detection, and cycle time

6. Team Leadership and Collaboration

- Lead, mentor, and develop up to five QA Engineers

- Build a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing Quality Engineering culture

- Provide technical direction, coaching, feedback, and fair workload allocation

- Develop team capabilities in automation, product knowledge, AI, and Quality Engineering

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, UX, Operations, and Support

- Lead root-cause analysis and ensure systemic preventive action

7. Quality Monitoring and Reporting

- Monitor test execution, defects, automation health, release risks, and production quality

- Build clear dashboards and executive-ready reports

- Convert quality data into concrete insights, actions, ownership, and recommendations

🌟 What You Will Gain

- Lead Quality Engineering for a platform serving nearly 500,000 users worldwide

- Shape the automation and AI-enabled testing strategy of a long-term global product

- Gain hands-on experience with OutSystems, GenAI, and Agentic AI

- Transform a QA team into a modern Quality Engineering capability

- Deliver measurable improvements in reliability, efficiency, release speed, and customer trust

- Build a significant career achievement in a global AI product transformation

🤝 Who Will Thrive Here

You will succeed if you:

- Stay technically hands-on while leading and developing others

- Treat quality as a product and engineering responsibility

- Prevent defects by challenging risks and unclear requirements early

- Use data and evidence to guide release decisions

- Apply AI responsibly to solve real testing challenges

- Seek long-term ownership and remain accountable through complexity

“I helped build the quality foundation of a global AI-native product and transformed how the team delivers software excellence.”

🧩 Selection Challenge

Shortlisted candidates may prepare a maximum 10-slide, six-month Quality Engineering improvement plan covering:

- Current quality risks and priorities

- Test strategy and coverage model

- Automation framework and CI/CD approach

- Integration, performance, and non-functional testing

- AI testing use cases and governance

- Team capability and coaching plan

- Quality KPIs and reporting

- Prioritized 30/60/90-day roadmap

Evaluation criteria: technical depth, leadership maturity, prioritization, measurable outcomes, and the ability to balance quality with delivery speed.

📩 Ready to Engineer Quality at Global Scale?

If you are a hands-on Test Lead who wants to build an AI-enabled Quality Engineering capability and influence a product used by nearly half a million people, this is your opportunity.

Join us and build the quality foundation for the future of intelligent workflows

Szeretnél ötleteiddel hasznos technológiák fejlesztéséhez hozzájárulni? Legyen szó mobilitási megoldásokról, fogyasztói cikkekről, ipari technológiáról, energetikáról vagy építéstechnológiáról: Velünk lehetőséged nyílik arra, hogy javíts az emberek életminőségén világszerte.

Köszöntünk a Bosch világában.

Az 1998-ban alapított hatvani telephely a Bosch csoport gépjármű-elektronika részlegének legnagyobb gyártó központja a világon. A vállalat fő profilja a cégcsoport mobilitási megoldások üzletágának jövőbe mutató termékei közül a vezérlő elektronikák, szenzorok, radarok és kamerarendszerek sorozatgyártása. A hatvani stratégiai célja, hogy munkavállalói szakértelmének, valamint csúcstechnológiát képviselő gyártási megoldásainak folyamatos fejlesztésével az automatizált, balesetmentes és környezetbarát autózás jövőjében aktív szerepet vállaljon.

Feladataid, amelyekkel hozzájárulhatsz közös céljaink megvalósításához:

- Mérnöki instrukciók alapján műszaki rajzokat készítesz

- Naprakészen vezeted és folyamatosan aktualizálod a megrendelési nyilvántartást

- Támogatod az eszközleltározási folyamatot, a leltározó csapat munkáját

- Kezeled a beérkező és kimenő csomagokat (csomagátvétel, csomagküldés)

- Karbantartod a szállítólevelek digitális tárát

- Adminisztrálod a bevételezési folyamatokat

jobs.description:
보쉬 그룹은 선도적인 글로벌 기술 및 서비스 기업입니다.

보쉬 그룹의 사업은 모빌리티(Mobility), 산업 기술(Industrial Technology), 소비재(Consumer Goods), 에너지 및 빌딩 기술(Energy and Building Technology)의 4개 사업 부문으로 구성되어 있습니다.

선도적인 IoT 공급 업체로서 보쉬는 스마트 홈, 인더스트리 4.0, 커넥티드 모빌리티 분야에서 혁신적인 솔루션들을 제공하고 있으며, 지속가능하고 안전하며 흥미로운 모빌리티라는 비전을 추구하고 있습니다. 또한 자사의 센서 기술, 소프트웨어, 서비스, IoT 클라우드와 같은 전문성을 활용하여 고객사들에게 단일 공급원(single source)으로서 연결되고 영역을 넘나드는 솔루션들을 제공합니다.

보쉬 그룹의 전략적 목표는 인공 지능(AI)을 포함하거나 그 도움을 받아 개발 또는 제조된 제품 및 솔루션으로 연결된 커넥티드 생활(connected living)을 가능하게 하고 혁신적이고 매력적인 제품 및 서비스를 통해 삶의 질을 향상시켜주는 “생활 속의 기술(Invented for life)”을 선보이는 것입니다.

보쉬 그룹은 로버트 보쉬 GmbH(Robert Bosch GmbH) 및 60여 개국에 진출해 있는 470여 개의 자회사 및 현지 법인으로 구성되어 있으며, 세일즈 및 서비스 파트너를 포함, 보쉬의 글로벌 생산, 엔지니어링 및 세일즈 네트워크는 전 세계 대부분의 국가에 진출해 있습니다.

- 내연기관, 하이브리드 및 전기차(EV) 차량의 전자제어장치(ECU) 성능 및 진단 캘리브레이션 업무 수행

- ECU 데이터 관리 및 차량 사양에 최적화된 성능과 진단 기능 구현을 위한 캘리브레이션 수행

- 프로젝트 목표, 품질 기준 및 개발 로드맵에 따른 차량 개발 업무 수행

- 고객 요구사항 분석 및 고객 맞춤형 기술 솔루션 개발 / 고객 대상 기술 지원 및 국내·외 차량 시험 업무 수행

- 개발 및 시험 과정에서 발생하는 기술 문제의 원인 분석 및 해결 지원

Möchten Sie Ihre Ideen in nutzbringende und sinnvolle Technologien verwandeln? Ob im Bereich Mobility Solutions, Consumer Goods, Industrial Technology oder Energy and Building Technology – mit uns verbessern Sie die Lebensqualität der Menschen auf der ganzen Welt.

Willkommen bei Bosch.

Rund um den Globus steigt die Nachfrage nach Sicherheits- und Kommunikationslösungen, die den Menschen das Gefühl von Schutz und Geborgenheit geben. Der Bosch Geschäftsbereich Building Technologies ist einer der führenden Anbieter in diesem wachsenden Markt.

Wir suchen Sie, um am Standort Augsburg den langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens zu sichern.

Die Bosch Sicherheitssysteme Montage und Service GmbH freut sich auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Von Brandmeldeanlagen über Einbruchmeldeanlagen bis hin zu sensorgestützten Lösungen: Dank unserer innovativen Technologien, sorgen wir dafür, dass Menschen sich in Gebäuden sicher fühlen können. Und mit Ihnen suchen wir jemanden, der diese Systeme vor Ort beim Kunden im Gebiet Augsburg realisiert!

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Instandhaltung, Wartung & Entstörung von sicherheitstechnischen Systemen

jobs.description:
- 打造面向自动驾驶的下一代数据与仿真引擎，探索 3D Gaussian Splatting、神经渲染与生成式 AI 在真实道路场景重建、仿真视频生成与闭环评测中的落地应用。

- 参与从真实路测数据重建、可控场景编辑、动态目标建模，到仿真引擎集成与自动驾驶算法验证的完整链路研发，推动 3DGS 技术真正服务于 ADAS / 自动驾驶系统的数据生产、场景泛化与闭环评测。

- 设计与实现基于 3D Gaussian Splatting / Neural Rendering 的自动驾驶场景重建算法；

- 研究大规模道路场景中的多传感器重建、相机轨迹优化、几何一致性、时序一致性与渲染质量提升方法；

- 构建面向 LogSim / WorldSim 的 3DGS 仿真资产生产链路，支持真实道路场景的高保真复现与可控编辑；

- 研究动态目标重建与插入、车道级场景编辑、天气 / 光照 / 材质变化等场景泛化能力；

- 推动 3DGS 结果与仿真引擎、自动驾驶感知 / 规划系统集成，实现从重建、渲染到闭环评测的数据闭环；

- 优化 3DGS 训练、渲染与推理效率，支持大规模场景生产与工程化部署；

- 与感知、规划、仿真、数据生产团队协作，将重建与生成式仿真数据用于算法训练、验证与性能评估。
jobs.requirements_raw:
- 硕士及以上学历，计算机科学、人工智能、电子信息、自动化、测绘、机器人等相关专业；

- 熟悉 PyTorch / CUDA / Python / C++ 等深度学习与图形学相关开发工具；

- 具备 3D Gaussian Splatting、NeRF、Neural Rendering、3D Reconstruction、SLAM、SfM、MVS 中至少一类相关研发经验；

- 理解相机模型、多视图几何、三维重建、坐标变换、位姿优化、Bundle Adjustment 等基础理论；

- 熟悉自动驾驶场景数据处理流程，能够处理相机、LiDAR、IMU、GNSS 等多传感器数据者优先；

- 具备较强的工程落地能力，能够将算法原型转化为稳定、可规模化运行的生产链路；

- 具备良好的问题分析能力，能够针对重建质量、动态目标、跨视角一致性、渲染伪影等问题进行系统性优化。

加分项

- 熟悉 3DGS、Street Gaussian、PVG、EmerNeRF、UniSim、DriveDreamer、Cosmos、World Model 等相关方向；

jobs.title: Industrialization Project Manager_VM
jobs.description:
Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the chance to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch.

Job Summary:

Industrialization project leader is responsible for taking a new product from prototype to mass production. Act as the critical bridge between the Research & Development (R&D)/Engineering teams and the Manufacturing/Operations teams. The primary goal is to ensure that a product can be manufactured reliably, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.

Job Responsibilities:

- Project Planning and Management

- Develop Master Plan: Create, own, and manage the comprehensive industrialization project plan, including timelines, milestones, deliverables, and critical path analysis.

- Risk Management: Proactively identify potential risks to the project (technical, supply chain, quality, budget) and develop mitigation strategies.

- Resource Allocation: Coordinate with department heads to secure the necessary resources, including personnel, equipment, and facility space.

- Reporting and Communication: Provide regular status updates, reports, and presentations to key stakeholders, including senior management, on project progress, risks, and budget.

- Technical and Process Leadership

- Design for Manufacturability (DFM/DFA): Collaborate with the design engineering team early in the development cycle to ensure the product design is optimized for efficient manufacturing and assembly.

- Process Definition: Define, develop, and document the entire manufacturing process, from raw material intake to final product packaging.

- Tooling and Equipment: Lead the specification, procurement, installation, and qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) of all necessary manufacturing equipment, jigs, fixtures, and tooling.

- Pilot and Pre-production Runs: Plan and manage pilot production runs to test the manufacturing process, identify issues, and validate equipment and procedures before full-scale launch.

- Production Ramp-Up: Oversee the gradual increase in production volume (ramp-up), monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) like yield, cycle time, and quality.

- Documentation: Ensure all manufacturing documentation, such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and process control plans, are created, validated, and released.

- Cross-Functional Team Coordination

- Central Point of Contact: Act as the primary liaison between all involved departments, including R&D, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Production, and Marketing.

- Facilitate Collaboration: Lead cross-functional team meetings to drive decisions, resolve conflicts, and ensure alignment on project goals.

- Manage Stakeholder Expectations: Clearly communicate project objectives and constraints to all stakeholders to ensure a shared understanding and manage expectations.

- Quality and Compliance

- Quality Standards: Work with the Quality Assurance team to define quality criteria, inspection methods, and control plans for the product and process.

- Validation and Qualification: Ensure that the manufacturing process is fully validated to consistently produce products that meet specifications.

- Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the manufacturing process and facility comply with all relevant industry standards and government regulations (e.g., ISO, FDA, CE).

- Root Cause Analysis: Lead problem-solving efforts for any failures or deviations encountered during pilot runs and production ramp-up.

- Supply Chain and Procurement

- Supplier Qualification: Collaborate with the procurement team to identify, evaluate, and qualify suppliers for critical components and raw materials.

- Material Readiness: Ensure a stable and qualified supply chain is in place to support production launch and ramp-up.

- Bill of Materials (BOM) Management: Oversee the transition of the Engineering BOM (eBOM) to a Manufacturing BOM (mBOM), ensuring accuracy and completeness.

- Financial and Budget Management

- Budget Development: Develop and manage the project budget, including Capital Expenditures (CapEx) for equipment and Operational Expenditures (OpEx) for materials and labor.

- Cost Tracking: Monitor project spending against the budget and report on any variances.

- Cost Optimization: Continuously look for opportunities to reduce manufacturing costs without compromising quality

We are looking for a motivated intern to help us continue developing our machine-learning solutions for heat pump reliability. You will build on what we've already started, work on improving our current models, and explore how we can apply these ideas to additional reliability use cases. Most of your work will be done in Databricks.

- During your internship, you will contribute to the review and enhancement of existing data preparation and feature engineering approaches.

- You will support the optimization and evaluation of existing machine learning models.

- In addition, you will investigate potential new features and early risk indicators within field and IoT data.

- You will also develop reproducible ML workflows in Databricks using MLflow.

- Furthermore, you will adapt and assess existing approaches for additional product issues and reliability-related use cases.

- Finally, you will communicate findings through data visualizations, short presentations, and technical documentation.

jobs.description:
Chez Bosch, nous façonnons le futur en inventant des technologies de pointe et des services qui visent à susciter l’enthousiasme et améliorer la vie quotidienne.

Nous vous offrons de travailler sur des métiers passionnants dans un contexte de travail international et un environnement innovant et dynamique. Bosch France est une filiale du Groupe Bosch, l’une des plus grandes sociétés industrielles privées au monde, qui emploie plus de 402 000 personnes et réalise un chiffre d’affaires annuel de 78 milliards d’euros. Nos produits enthousiasment nos clients, améliorent leur qualité de vie et contribuent à préserver les ressources naturelles.

Notre promesse en tant qu’employeur : grandir ensemble, apprécier notre travail et s’inspirer les uns et les unes des autres. Rejoignez-nous et voyez la différence.

https://www.bosch.fr/carrieres/pourquoi-bosch/

DESCRIPTION DE LA DIVISION

Bosch Home Comfort Group est l'un des principaux fabricants européens de solutions éco-performantes de chauffage, de production d’eau chaude, de rafraîchissement domestiques et industrielles durables et économes en énergie. L'entreprise a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 4,5 milliards d’euros en 2022 et emploie 14 400 personnes. Bosch Home Comfort Group possède de fortes marques internationales et régionales, et fabrique une gamme de produits diversifiée en Europe, en Amérique et en Asie.

En France, Bosch Home Comfort Group comprend les marques Bosch et elm.leblanc et fabrique dans ses deux usines de Drancy (93) et Saint-Thégonnec (29). L’entreprise emploie 900 collaborateurs sur tout le territoire.

Plaçant toujours l’utilisateur au coeur de sa démarche, l’entreprise conçoit et fabrique une gamme de produits toujours plus innovants et des solutions conçues pour optimiser le confort du bâti et le rendre toujours plus agréable.

Notre ambition est de muscler notre présence sur le marché de l’électrification avec le déploiement des pompes à chaleur air/eau, air/air et hybrides.

www.bosch-homecomfort.fr ; www.elmleblanc.fr

Intégré(e) à l'équipe SAV, vous contribuerez à l'amélioration de la qualité de service et à l'automatisation des processus en développant des solutions innovantes basées sur l'IA et les plateformes d'automatisation. Vos principales missions seront :

• Concevoir, développer et déployer des chatbots intelligents pour répondre aux questions fréquentes des clients concernant l'entretien et la réparation de leurs chaudières.

• Automatiser l'envoi de courriers et de notifications (e-mails) pour informer les clients sur l'état de leurs demandes, les délais d'intervention, etc.

• Analyser les données du SAV pour identifier les points d'amélioration et proposer des solutions d'automatisation.

• Documenter les solutions développées et assurer leur maintenance.

Cette liste de tâches est non exhaustive et pourra évoluer en fonction des besoins du service et de vos compétences.

Diplôme préparé : Bac+4/5

Type de formation : Licence professionnelle en informatique, Master en Informatique, spécialisation en IA, Data Science, développement web, ou école d'ingénieur généraliste avec une appétence pour l'automatisation et l'IA.

Date de début d’apprentissage souhaitée : septembre 2026

Durée de l’apprentissage : 1/2 ans

A Boschnál kiváló minőségű, lelkesedést kiváltó és az emberek életét gazdagabbá tevő technológiák és szolgáltatások kigondolásával formáljuk a jövőt. Sziklaszilárd ígéretet tettünk dolgozóinknak: együtt fejlődünk, élvezzük a munkánkat, és kölcsönösen inspiráljuk egymást. Üdvözlünk a Boschnál.

A Robert Bosch Energy and Body Systems Kft. 2003 nyarán alakult, járműipari alkatrészek és elektromos hajtások gyártásával foglalkozik és mára több mint 2500 munkavállalót foglalkoztat. Cégünk első számú beszállítója számos autó- és eBike gyártónak, és a leggyorsabban fejlődő gyárak egyike a régióban.

A Te feladataid:

- A logisztikai tervezési folyamatok folyamatos fejlesztése, fejlesztési lehetőségek azonosítása és fejlesztési projektek vezetése.

- Központi logisztikai projektek bevezetésének és koordinációjának támogatása a miskolci gyárban, együttműködve belső és külső partnerekkel.

- A logisztikai folyamatokhoz kapcsolódó dokumentációk elkészítése és naprakészen tartása az auditkövetelményeknek megfelelően.

- Projektjelentések, elemzések és egyéb belső vagy külső riportok készítése.

- Rendszeres szakmai képzések és tudásmegosztó alkalmak szervezése és lebonyolítása az operatív logisztikai tervezők számára.

- A termelési rendszerek, problémamegoldó módszerek és projektmenedzsment eszközök alkalmazása a hatékony működés érdekében.

- KPI-követő és napi tervezést támogató digitális megoldások fejlesztése és karbantartása SAP, Power BI és AI-alapú eszközök felhasználásával.

- A logisztikai folyamatok átláthatóságának növelése, a problémák megelőzésének támogatása és a hatékonyság javítása.

- Nyitott szemlélettel új módszerek, technológiák és innovatív megoldások keresése saját és a csapat működésének folyamatos fejlesztése érdekében.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Felsőfokú végzettség mérnöki, gazdaságinformatikai, informatikai vagy gazdasági területen.

- Legalább 3-5 év projektmenedzsment területen szerzett szakmai tapasztalat.

- Operatív logisztikai tervezésben szerzett 3-5 éves tapasztalat előnyt jelent.

- Magabiztos SAP S/4HANA, Power BI és AI-alapú megoldások ismerete.

- Együttműködési készség és csapatmunkára való nyitottság.

- Célorientáltság, analitikus gondolkodásmód és problémamegoldó képesség.

- Proaktív, rugalmas hozzáállás, valamint felelősségvállalási hajlandóság.

- Tárgyalóképes angol nyelvtudás, komplex szakmai témák magabiztos kommunikálása szóban és írásban.

Előnyt jelent:

- Német nyelvtudás.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager(Target Costing)_ EM
jobs.description:
Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the chance to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch.

Job Summary

The TPM – Target Costing is responsible for target costing and cost competitiveness of eDrive products throughout the product development lifecycle. The position drives cross-functional cost optimization activities and ensures that product cost targets are defined, monitored and achieved in alignment with project targets.

Major Responsibilities

- Lead target costing activities for eDrive projects and ensure alignment with project targets.

- Establish and maintain product cost targets, cost structures and cost controlling.

- Lead cost optimization idea generation, feasibility assessment and business case calculation.

- Identify cost gaps and drive cross-functional measures to achieve target cost.

- Coordinate engineering, purchasing, manufacturing, finance and project teams for cost optimization activities.

- Monitor and control cost improvement measures, project cost status and deviations.

- Manage cost-related risks, issues and change requests.

- Prepare and lead cost reviews and management reporting.

- Support product development projects from concept phase through ramp-up and SOP.

- Drive best practices and synergies for target costing across eDrive projects and platforms.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Bachelor or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Finance or related fields.

- 3–5+ years of experience in automotive project management, target costing, cost engineering or controlling.

- Good knowledge of product cost calculation, target costing and cost optimization.

- Automotive/eDrive product development experience is a plus.

- Strong project management, analytical and influencing skills.

- Fluent in English with good intercultural communication skills.

- PMP certification is preferred; NPDP is a plus.

Praktikum im Bereich Machine Learning für prädiktive Zuverlässigkeitsanalytik – Wärmepumpen (w/m/div.)
jobs.description:
Bei Bosch gestalten wir die Zukunft, indem wir hochwertige Technologien und Dienstleistungen entwickeln, die begeistern und das Leben der Menschen bereichern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeitenden ist felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, wir haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und wir inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Machen Sie mit und spüren Sie den Unterschied. Die Bosch Home Comfort Group freut sich auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Wir suchen eine engagierte Praktikantin bzw. einen engagierten Praktikanten, um die Weiterentwicklung unserer Machine-Learning-Lösungen zur Zuverlässigkeit von Wärmepumpen zu unterstützen. Sie bauen auf den bereits gestarteten Arbeiten auf, verbessern unsere bestehenden Modelle und prüfen, wie sich diese Ansätze auf weitere Zuverlässigkeits-Anwendungsfälle übertragen lassen. Der Großteil Ihrer Arbeit findet in Databricks statt.

Während Ihres Praktikums tragen Sie zur Überprüfung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Ansätze zur Datenaufbereitung und zum Feature Engineering bei. Sie unterstützen die Optimierung und Evaluation vorhandener Machine-Learning-Modelle. Darüber hinaus untersuchen Sie potenzielle neue Features sowie frühe Risikoindikatoren in Feld- und IoT-Daten. Sie entwickeln außerdem reproduzierbare ML-Workflows in Databricks unter Einsatz von MLflow. Des Weiteren passen Sie bestehende Ansätze für zusätzliche Produktprobleme und weitere zuverlässigkeitsbezogene Use Cases an und bewerten diese. Zudem erkunden Sie den Einsatz von Generativer KI, um Modellergebnisse und wesentliche Risikotreiber in prägnante und gut verständliche Berichte für Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieure zu überführen. Abschließend kommunizieren Sie Ihre Erkenntnisse mittels Datenvisualisierungen, kurzer Präsentationen und technischer Dokumentation.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Ausbildung: Masterstudium im Bereich Data Science, Künstliche Intelligenz, Informatik, Informationssysteme, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren quantitativen bzw. technischen Fachgebiet

- Erfahrung und Kenntnisse: Praktische Kenntnisse in Machine Learning, Modellevaluierung, Feature Engineering und Datenvorverarbeitung; sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse; Erfahrung mit Databricks, MLflow, PySpark oder Anwendungen im Bereich Generative AI ist von Vorteil

- Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: Sie zeichnen sich dadurch aus, Aufgaben eigenständig voranzutreiben, Ihre Arbeitsabläufe systematisch zu organisieren und technische Ergebnisse sehr klar zu kommunizieren

- Arbeitsmodell: Wir bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell zu arbeiten, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz in Wernau

- Interesse: Interesse daran, Machine Learning auf reale Produkte und IoT-Daten anzuwenden

- Sprachen: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

jobs.description:
岗位职责

- 面向车道线、道路边界、路面标识、交通标志及其他静态道路设施，研发多帧融合、跨视角关联、几何与语义联合优化算法，提升标注精度、完整性及空间一致性。

- 利用离线全序列信息，结合高精度定位、SLAM、三维重建及视觉基础模型，提升复杂场景、遮挡区域和长尾要素的自动化处理能力。

- 建立静态数据的质量标准、评测体系与问题归因机制，推动自动质检、置信度评估、人工复核及难例回流，形成可持续迭代的数据生产闭环。

- 推动算法从原型验证走向规模化生产，持续优化计算效率、资源消耗和处理稳定性，平衡数据质量、生产成本与交付时效。
jobs.requirements_raw:
任职要求

- 计算机、自动化、电子工程、机器人、数学等相关专业硕士及以上学历，或具备同等水平的相关实践经验。

- 具备扎实的计算机视觉、三维几何与机器学习基础，在自动驾驶感知、自动标注、三维重建或地图生产等领域具有深入研发经验。

- 熟悉多视角几何、多传感器融合、点云处理、语义分割、目标检测、矢量化表达等技术中的多项，并能够针对实际数据问题设计完整方案。

- 熟悉相机与激光雷达标定、时空同步及定位误差对数据质量的影响，具备跨模块分析和定位问题的能力。

- 熟练使用 Python、C++ 中至少一种语言，熟悉主流深度学习框架，具备算法部署、性能分析及大规模数据处理经验。

- 有主导复杂算法项目落地的经历，能够制定技术路线、评估关键风险，并通过量化指标验证改进效果。

- 具备良好的跨团队沟通能力，能够将业务需求转化为清晰的算法目标、数据规范及交付标准。

加分项

- 有静态场景自动标注、离线感知、高精地图或 BEV 数据生产的量产项目经验。

- 有视觉基础模型、半监督学习、主动学习或模型辅助标注的实际应用经验。

- 有复杂路口、异形道路、施工区域等长尾场景的算法优化经验。

- 有云端 GPU 计算优化、分布式推理或大规模离线算法生产经验。

At Bosch Mobility Aftermarket, we believe in creating a work culture that embodies our core values of grow, enjoy, and inspire. Our Mobility Aftermarket division provides diagnostic and repair shop equipment, spare parts, and repair solutions for passenger cars and commercial vehicles worldwide. Our Automotive Service Solutions operations supply testing and repair-shop technology, diagnostic software, service training, and information services.Our OE Wiper operations has several plants globally serving the OE's with innovative wiper arms.

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills and knowledge while working with cutting-edge technology. We want you to enjoy what you do and feel inspired to contribute your best to our customers and to the growth of our business. We believe that by cultivating a work environment that encourages personal and professional growth, enjoyment, and inspiration, we can achieve great things together.

Join us at Bosch Mobility Aftermarket and help us shape the future of mobility!

The Key Account Manager serves as the primary strategic interface and "voice of the customer" between Bosch and its most high-profile, high-impact national accounts. Operating with an entrepreneurial mindset, the E4 KAM is responsible for driving sustainable, profitable sales growth, establishing absolute alignment across global supply chains, and positioning Bosch as the preferred technology and service partner.

The associate is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, leading cross-functional teams without disciplinary authority to resolve complex operational, pricing, and logistical challenges, while securing long-term strategic agreements. The role requires strong project management capabilities, with the ability to simultaneously lead multiple complex initiatives from concept through implementation, coordinating numerous internal functions and customer stakeholders while managing scope, timing, resources, risks, and deliverables

自动驾驶数据闭环产品经理_XC
jobs.description:
岗位职责

- 负责自动驾驶数据闭环产品的规划、设计与持续迭代，围绕 数据采集、数据回传、数据挖掘、数据筛选、数据标注、自动标注、数据质检、数据版本管理、训练数据交付 等核心环节，建设端到端的数据闭环能力。

- 深入理解自动驾驶感知、预测、规控及端到端模型的数据需求，与算法、数据、研发、测试及业务团队协作，将模型需求转化为可落地的数据产品需求，包括：

- 场景定义与数据需求拆解；

- Corner Case / Failure Case 挖掘；

- 数据 Tag / Label / Ontology 体系设计；

- 数据集构建及版本管理；

- 数据覆盖度、质量及生产效率指标设计。

- 负责数据闭环平台产品设计，包括但不限于：

- 数据检索与数据资产管理；

- 场景 Tagging 与数据 Mining；

- 自动标注 / 预标注平台；

- 人工标注生产流程；

- 数据质检与验收；

- Dataset 管理与数据交付；

- 数据生产任务管理及运营看板。

- 建立数据生产和运营指标体系，从 Coverage、Quality、Efficiency、Cost、Delivery 等维度持续衡量数据闭环效果，例如：

- 场景覆盖率；

- 数据有效率；

- 标注准确率及召回率；

- 自动标注覆盖率；

- 人均生产效率；

- 单位数据生产成本；

- 数据需求交付周期。

- 与算法团队紧密合作，理解模型训练、评测以及 Failure Case，建立从：

模型问题 → 场景定义 → 数据检索 / 挖掘 → 数据生产 → 数据训练 → 模型评测

的闭环流程，持续提升数据对模型迭代的贡献效率。

- 推动自动化、智能化数据生产能力建设，引入自动标注、VLM、多模态模型、数据挖掘算法、合成数据等能力，提高数据生产效率并降低人工成本。

- 负责产品 Roadmap、PRD、流程设计及需求优先级管理，协调算法、平台、数据生产及项目团队推动产品落地，对产品交付结果负责。

- 跟踪行业数据闭环技术及产品趋势，包括自动驾驶 Data Engine、Data Flywheel、Synthetic Data、Foundation Model、World Model 等方向，并结合实际业务推动能力演进。
jobs.requirements_raw:
任职要求

- 本科及以上学历，计算机、人工智能、自动化、车辆工程、软件工程等相关专业优先。

- 具备 3 年及以上产品、数据平台、自动驾驶或 AI 相关工作经验；有自动驾驶数据闭环、数据平台或 AI 数据产品经验优先。

- 对自动驾驶数据链路有较深入理解，了解以下一个或多个领域：

- 自动驾驶感知数据；

- Camera / LiDAR / Radar 等传感器数据；

- 2D / 3D / BEV / OCC / Map 等数据形态；

- 数据标注与自动标注；

- 数据 Mining 与场景检索；

- 模型训练与评测数据集。

- 具备较强的数据分析能力，能够通过数据指标发现数据生产流程及模型数据需求中的问题。

Your contribution to something big:

In this role, you will be an important link between our users, Product Owner, development teams, and other internal stakeholders. You will provide hands-on operational and first-level support for our MAM/DAM solutions, independently handling day-to-day requests and ensuring that incidents are resolved efficiently and to a high standard. Beyond support, you will contribute to the ongoing operation and improvement of our products, gradually taking on more responsibility for configuration and product-related tasks.

- First-Level Support and Issue Handling:

- Act as the first point of contact for users of our MAM/DAM solutions.

- Independently handle first-level support requests related to errors, changes, extensions, access, user administration, content, and data.

- Analyze incoming tickets, reproduce issues where possible, collect relevant information, and determine the appropriate next steps.

- Troubleshoot functional and technical issues to identify suitable solutions.

- Resolve issues independently where possible, or escalate them to the responsible Product Owner, Engineering, IT, or other support teams.

- Follow up on open issues and ensure that requests are handled within agreed timelines.

- Maintain clear and accurate ticket documentation and communicate status and resolution directly to users.

- MAM/DAM Data, Content and User Administration:

- Support users with day-to-day questions and activities related to MAM/DAM data and content.

- Assist with user and access administration, including investigating permission or access-related issues.

- Support data-related activities and help identify inconsistencies or problems within content and metadata.

- Analyze data and system information to identify the root cause of issues.

- Develop a deep understanding of how content, metadata, workflows, users, permissions, and system components interact within the MAM/DAM environment.

- Product and Development Support:

- Work closely with the Product Owner to support the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of the product.

- Track product-related issues, feature requests, changes, and improvements through the development lifecycle.

- Support the maintenance and refinement of the product backlog by gathering information, clarifying requirements, and documenting user needs.

- Monitor the progress of assigned product initiatives and proactively highlight potential blockers or dependencies.

- Support testing, validation, and rollout of product changes and bug fixes.

- Over time, take responsibility for implementing simple configuration changes and selected bug fixes where appropriate.

- User Training and Documentation:

- Support users by providing guidance and troubleshooting assistance.

- Create and maintain user guides, FAQs, training materials, and internal documentation.

- Document recurring issues and solutions to improve knowledge sharing and reduce repetitive support requests.

- Help establish and maintain a useful knowledge base for MAM/DAM users and internal teams.

- Feedback and Continuous Improvement:

- Collect and structure user feedback, recurring support issues, feature requests, and improvement suggestions.

- Identify recurring problems and work with the Product Owner and relevant teams to address their root causes.

- Identify opportunities to improve support processes, workflows, documentation, and product operations.

- Help standardize processes and best practices across the product and support environment.

- Use support data and user feedback to highlight trends and potential product improvements.

- Collaboration and Product Operations:

- Maintain and use tools such as Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, and relevant MAM/DAM platforms.

- Ensure that product and support information is kept accurate, structured, and up to date.

- Contribute to an efficient and transparent way of working across the product team.

- Participate in an agile development environment and relevant team ceremonies.

- Work as part of a global team and collaborate with an international user and stakeholder community.

jobs.title: PhD - Predictive Occupancy World Models for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
jobs.description:
At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference.

The Robert Bosch GmbH is looking forward to your application!

The Corporate Research division is the heart of our innovation. You will be part of the Bosch Research Computer Vision and AI Lab in Hildesheim, Germany, at the forefront of developing the next generation of autonomous systems. We are looking for a passionate and creative PhD candidate to join our team and help shape the future of AI-driven mobility.

- You will develop a generic predictive occupancy model as the core representation of the driving scene, designing architectures that capture the geometry and semantics of all objects to enable an explicit understanding of 4D world dynamics.

- Furthermore, you will research, implement, and evaluate novel end-to-end (E2E) driving architectures based on predictive occupancy world models, ensuring robust situational awareness and safe navigation.

- You will develop state-of-the-art perception systems that seamlessly transform raw sensor data into rich spatial representations and driving actions, bridging the gap between perception and automated driving.

- As part of this role, you will create architectures in which driving decisions are directly based on predictive occupancy world models, ensuring spatially grounded and reliable actions.

- Last but not least, you will rigorously test your models in simulation and with real-world data, demonstrating improvements in safety, transparency, and performance, and you will publish your findings at leading AI and robotics conferences.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Education: excellent master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field that qualifies you for doctoral studies

- Experience and Knowledge: strong expertise in Deep Learning and Computer Vision (CV), hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch), and proven Python programming skills; experience in 3D Computer Vision, Occupancy Networks, End-to-End (E2E) Driving, World Models, or Sensor Fusion is highly desirable; familiarity with autonomous driving datasets and simulation environments (e.g., CARLA) is considered an advantage

- Personality and Working Practice: you are a creative and self-driven researcher who enjoys taking ownership of challenging topics, developing innovative ideas comes naturally to you, and you thrive both independently and in technical discussions with colleagues

- Enthusiasm: you have a genuine passion for solving fundamental AI challenges and are driven to build systems that are not only intelligent but also trustworthy and safe

- Languages: excellent English skills, German is an advantage

jobs.description:
The Bosch Research and Technology Center North America with offices in Sunnyvale, California, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and Cambridge, Massachusetts is a part of the global Bosch Group (www.bosch.com), a company with over 70 billion euro revenue, 400,000 employees worldwide, a very diverse product portfolio, and a history spanning over 125 years. The Research and Technology Center North America (RTC-NA) is dedicated to providing technologies and system solutions for various Bosch business fields, primarily in the field of artificial intelligence, energy technologies, internet technologies, circuit design, semiconductors and wireless, as well as advanced MEMS design.

As a part of the global research, our AI research in Silicon Valley focuses on Foundation Models, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision & Mixed Reality, Cloud Robotics, Big Data Visual Analytics, Explainable AI (XAI), Data Science, AI System Engineering, Time-series Analysis. We develop scalable, intelligent, and trustworthy AIoT solutions for Bosch products and services in application areas such as automated driving, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), robotics, smart manufacturing, enterprise AI, health care, smart home and building solutions.

Originating from the AI research in Silicon Valley, our Foundation Model Powered AI Enablers group plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of industrial AI experiences for Bosch products and services. By fusing cutting-edge machine learning, data analysis, and interactive visualization technologies, we research and develop scalable and transparent AI & big data analytic solutions (e.g., audio, images, sensor logs) for a range of domains, including Industry 4.0 (I4.0), IoT, autonomous driving, and connected vehicles. Our award-winning team (IEEE VIS best paper & best paper runner-ups) actively collaborates with leading academic and industry groups to advance research ideas and disseminate findings in top AI conferences and journals, such as CVPR, ICCV, ICRA, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, TVCG.

Job Responsibilites:

- Develop and lead research of AI projects that label, predict, classify, cluster, describe and fuse multi-sensor data (including acoustic, telemetry timeseries signals, vibration, radar, lidar, image, Wi-Fi, and ultrasound data), to improve / enable advance driver assistance system (ADAS) functionality in vehicles and AI functionalities in other Bosch products.

- Architect, design and validate multi-modal deep learning and Timeseries Foundation Models (TSFM) to work with multivariate time series signals.

- Integrate and extend timeseries models to leverage information from other auxiliary modalities such as videos and images to enhance context understanding.

- Offer expert insights to the management team in relevant technology sectors, aiding in strategic planning, R&D trajectory, and investment decisions.

- Stay abreast of the latest technological innovations, document and disseminate research findings through high-caliber publications and/or patent submissions.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Basic Qualifications

- Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline OR Masters degree with 2-3 years of preferred professional experience

- Expertise with Time Series FMs (beyond the time series task of forecasting)

- In-depth experience in signal processing for sensor data and their integration with deep-learning methods

- Proficiency in Python, PyTorch (including libraries such as torchaudio, torchvision, torchmetrics), familiarity with PyTorch Lightning

- A strong publication record in relevant venues such as ICASSP, NeurIPS, InterSpeech, ICML, ICLR, KDD, ICRA, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV or equivalent contributions to the field such as patents or significant open-source projects

- Strong interpersonal, communication, and teamwork capabilities

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in industrial research

- Experience with one or more of the following areas: data-centric AI, synthetic data generation, agentic AI

- Proficiency with version control systems (Git), integrated development environment (VSCode or PyCharm) and experience with experiment tracking tools (MLFlow)

- Familiarity with high-performance computing systems and job schedulers (Slurm, LSF)

- Hands-on experience in product development in the above-mentioned areas for consumer/enterprise markets

- Experience leading projects with small teams, demonstrating the ability to mentor junior researchers and interns, manage project timelines, and deliver results within time constraints

jobs.description:
The Bosch Group has more than 400 000 employees around the world, present in 60 countries, and we are proud to impact people’s lives and to work towards a more sustainable future.

Bosch Car Multimedia, S.A. belongs to the Automotive Electronics division and is focused on making the vehicles our third living space. About 3.600 associates are committed to develop and produce high quality technology that shape change in mobility worldwide. The company' success lies in its highly specialized and innovative team, and on the technological know-how which makes Bosch the leading supplier in the automotive market.

At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference in mindsets, cultures, generations, identities and perspectives. Everyone should bring their authenticity and work together respectfully. Bosch is an employer that values diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process and in the performance of professional activity. By including everyone and ensuring equal opportunities we unleash our full potential.

Your contribution to something big:

As a Reliability Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the robustness, quality, and long-term reliability of innovative Bosch products. By combining analytical thinking with experimental validation, you will help transform product requirements into reliable solutions that meet customer expectations and industry standards.

- Define product loads based on use cases, lifecycle expectations, and system requirements.

- Develop and evaluate simulations and engineering calculations to determine loads and effects on design elements, considering critical damage mechanisms.

- Plan, execute, and assess measurements and tests to determine the load capability and reliability of product components.

- Support product development teams with reliability-focused reviews and recommendations to improve product robustness and performance.

- Collaborate with internal and external customers to discuss reliability concepts, validation strategies, and technical solutions.

- Define validation plans and test concepts based on field conditions, industry standards, customer requirements, and aging mechanisms.

- Drive physical failure analysis activities and support root cause investigations, risk assessments, and corrective actions.

- Prepare technical reports and present results to project teams, stakeholders, and customers in English.

- Coordinate reliability-related activities including simulations, testing, failure analysis, and validation efforts across multidisciplinary teams.

Education

- Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, or a comparable field.

- Exposure to technical areas such as electronics, material science, simulation methods, or reliability testing is considered an advantage.

Know-how

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Understanding of reliability engineering principles, validation methodologies, and root cause analysis techniques.

- Ability to interpret technical data and derive meaningful engineering conclusions.

Languages

- Fluent English, both written and spoken.

- German language skills are an advantage.

Working Style and Methods

- Structured, detail-oriented, and proactive approach to work.

- Ability to manage multiple topics and coordinate activities across different stakeholders.

Personality

- Strong communication and presentation skills.

- Team-oriented mindset with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

- Curious, open-minded, and motivated to contribute to innovative engineering solutions.

jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

BGSV currently operates from three offices located at the following addresses:

1. Etown Building – 364 Cong Hoa Street, Ward 13, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

2. OfficeHaus Building – 32 Tan Thang Street, Son Ky Ward, Tan Phu District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

3. Capital Place Building – 29 Lieu Giai Street, Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, Vietnam

🎁Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS

Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary, subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.

About the Role

We are looking for 10 Senior Embedded Security Engineers to design, implement, and validate end-to-end security solutions on modern embedded platforms.

This role is open to candidates from multiple domains, including Automotive, IoT, Mobile Devices, and Embedded Systems.

If you have hands-on experience securing Linux / Android-based systems, SoCs, or connected devices, and are interested in working on automotive-grade platforms such as Infotainment (IVI) and ADAS, we strongly encourage you to apply.

You will work on modern SoC platforms (e.g. Qualcomm, Renesas, TI, Marvell) running Android Automotive, Linux, QNX, or AUTOSAR-based systems, contributing to secure, scalable, and production-ready embedded solutions.

Main Responsibilities

1. Security Architecture & Engineering

- Design and implement end-to-end security features for embedded platforms, including: Secure Boot, Trusted Execution Environments (TEE), Secure storage, Secure update mechanisms, Secure communication, etc...

-
Contribute to security architecture definition for embedded and connected systems.

2. Threat Modeling & Reviews

-
Perform security architecture reviews and threat modeling for infotainment, ADAS, IoT, or connected device platforms.

-
Identify risks, define mitigation strategies, and drive security improvements early in the development lifecycle.

3. Security Implementation & Hardening

-
Implement security hardening for Linux / Android / QNX systems.

-
Conduct secure code reviews and collaborate with development teams to address vulnerabilities.

-
Support integration of access control and system hardening mechanisms (e.g. SELinux, AppArmor).

4. Testing & Validation

-
Perform security testing and validation, including: Static and dynamic analysis, Fuzzing, Penetration testing

-
Validate security features on real hardware and production-like environments.

5. Process & Compliance

-
Develop and maintain security requirements and security engineering processes (SEP).

-
Support compliance with relevant security standards and best practices.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Mandatory Qualifications

-
Educational background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cryptography, or a related technical field

-
7-15 years of overall experience, with at least 2-5 years of experience in embedded software development, system software, or security engineering (backgrounds from Automotive, IoT, Mobile Devices, Consumer Electronics are all welcome)

-
Practical experience with Linux and/or Android platforms, particularly in BSP, middleware, system services, or other low-level system components.

-
Solid understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, including cryptography, secure communication protocols, secure coding practices, and security testing principles.

-
Hands-on experience implementing or supporting embedded system security features, such as secure boot, system trust mechanisms, secure storage, secure update/OTA, and secure communication between components or devices.

Nice-to-Have (Any of the following will be a strong advantage, but are not mandatory)

- Good knowledge or hands-on experience in development with modern SoC architectures, such as: Qualcomm, Renesas (RCAR), TI, etc.

- Experience in QNX development

- Relevant certifications (CEH, CISSP, OSCP, SANS GIAC, etc.)

- Good knowledge or hands-on experience in following areas:

- Secure Boot.

- Hardware-back security such as Trustzone (Arm TrustZone, OP-TEE, etc.), HSM, etc.

- Storage security (disk encryption, dm-verity, etc.).

- Secure communication protocols (TLS/DTLS, SSH, IPsec, MACsec, etc.).

- Access control & hardening (SELinux, AppArmor, etc.).

- Signing tools (Android signing, secure boot signing, etc.).

- Linux / Android / QNX security development/hardening.

- Network security, firewall.

- Security testing & validation (fuzzing, static/dynamic analysis, penetration testing, etc.).

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Warehouse Production Planner to join our team. The Production Planner plays a critical role in orchestrating the seamless flow of customer orders through our warehouse, ensuring efficient operations and on-time delivery. This individual will be a key liaison, collaborating with various cross-functional departments to ensure materials are received, picked, packed, and staged precisely according to customer schedules and established operating standards. The Production Planner will utilize a Warehouse Management System (WMS) to optimize workflow and contribute to achieving operational excellence.

jobs.description:
岗位概述

聚焦自动驾驶感知、规划（Planner）核心算法的数据闭环建设，核心主打模型Corner Case（极限长尾失效场景）挖掘与治理，主导整合现有数据挖掘能力、标签体系、场景体系，兼顾数据挖掘工具/平台能力建设与端到端数据成果交付落地。基于量产路测、仿真、多传感器数据，通过系统化平台工具搭建、标准化标签治理、精准的Corner Case挖掘与高质量数据交付，解决感知、规划模型长尾场景覆盖率低、隐性失效难发现、极限工况鲁棒性差等核心问题，统一数据交付标准与服务体系，为高阶NOA算法迭代、版本优化、量产落地提供平台能力与数据成果双重支撑。

核心工作职责

1. 数据能力与体系整合搭建

统筹整合自动驾驶现有数据挖掘能力、数据流程与资源链路，统一感知、规划（Planner）通用及专项数据闭环与交付体系；负责数据挖掘工具、自动化分析平台、筛选链路的迭代优化，同时制定分层场景挖掘策略、数据筛选提纯标准、数据交付规范与迭代机制，打通“平台能力建设—数据挖掘生产—算法交付落地”全链路，兼顾工具平台建设与高质量数据成果交付，搭建可复用、可规模化的数据驱动迭代体系。

2. 感知、Planner专项数据挖掘体系建设

专项负责感知、Planner模型Corner Case挖掘、聚类与归因治理。针对感知模块（检测、分割、跟踪、融合）与规划模块（轨迹预测、路径规划、决策博弈、避障逻辑），深度挖掘真实路测与仿真场景下的各类长尾场景、极限工况、隐性失效、偶发异常Corner Case，重点攻克模型常态化难复现、低概率失效、极端路况交互等痛点；精准定位模型漏检误检、延迟抖动、预测偏差、规划顿挫、决策不合理等核心问题，形成标准化的Corner Case挖掘、归类、根因分析、迭代复盘方法论。

3. 统一数据Tag标签体系搭建与治理

主导搭建适配感知、规划模型Corner Case专项治理的统一标签体系，包含场景维度、交通交互维度、模型失效维度、极限工况维度的专属标签规范；针对性设计Corner Case自动化识别、精准打标、分类聚类策略，建立标签质量校验与迭代治理机制，实现海量数据中高效筛选、精准沉淀各类长尾、极限失效案例，支撑模型Corner Case专项优化与问题量化统计。

4. 高质量数据集与场景库迭代

基于专属标签体系，聚焦感知、Planner模型Corner Case数据集迭代建设，专项扩充各类稀有场景、极端天气、复杂交通交互、异形障碍物、极限驾驶工况等长尾案例库与测试集；完成无效数据过滤、优质Corner Case样本提纯与均衡化处理，持续补齐模型场景短板、修复隐性失效问题，大幅提升感知、规划模型的泛化能力与复杂场景鲁棒性。

5. 数据驱动算法闭环迭代

深度对接感知、规划算法模型迭代需求，双向兼顾工具能力迭代与业务数据交付：一方面持续优化Corner Case自动化挖掘、智能归因、批量样本提纯工具与平台能力，提升长尾失效场景挖掘效率与精准度；另一方面承接模型迭代核心数据需求，负责端到端Corner Case问题案例、专项优化数据集、数据分析报告的落地交付，通过多轮数据复盘、版本对比分析，推动模型长尾问题收敛、极限工况性能优化，实现算法迭代闭环。

jobs.title: Associate Vehicle Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At Bosch Mobility Aftermarket, we believe in creating a work culture that embodies our core values of grow, enjoy, and inspire. Our Mobility Aftermarket division provides diagnostic and repair shop equipment, spare parts, and repair solutions for passenger cars and commercial vehicles worldwide. Our Automotive Service Solutions operations supply testing and repair-shop technology, diagnostic software, service training, and information services.

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills and knowledge while working with cutting-edge technology. We want you to enjoy what you do and feel inspired to contribute your best to our customers and to the growth of our business. We believe that by cultivating a work environment that encourages personal and professional growth, enjoyment, and inspiration, we can achieve great things together.

Join us at Bosch Mobility Aftermarket and help us shape the future of mobility!

We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical individual to join our team as an Associate Vehicle Data Analyst.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, investigating complex problems, identifying patterns, and transforming information into actionable insights. The successful candidate will play a key role in improving the quality, coverage, and performance of our vehicle diagnostic solutions for major North American automotive brands.

As an Associate Vehicle Data Analyst, you will leverage vehicle diagnostic data, service information, customer feedback, and product performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement, uncover root causes of issues, and support strategic product decisions. You will work closely with software developers, validation teams, content authors, and global engineering organizations to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality and customer satisfaction.

Success in this role requires a combination of analytical thinking, technical curiosity, automotive knowledge, and a passion for continuous learning.

Core Responsibilities:

Data Analysis & Investigation

- Analyze vehicle diagnostic data, validation results, quality metrics, and customer feedback to identify trends, anomalies, and improvement opportunities.

- Perform root-cause investigations to determine underlying causes of product quality issues and coverage gaps.

- Research and interpret OEM service information, repair procedures, and vehicle system documentation to support product development and validation activities.

- Develop data-driven recommendations to improve product quality, reliability, and customer experience.

- Convert large volumes of technical and diagnostic information into actionable insights for engineering and business teams.

Product & Validation Support

- Support the development and maintenance of vehicle coverage strategies for assigned automotive brands and vehicle platforms.

- Collaborate with validation teams to define test coverage priorities and ensure critical vehicle systems are adequately validated.

- Participate in the investigation and resolution of quality issues, Open Point Lists (OPLs), and customer-reported concerns.

- Monitor product performance and customer usage data to help prioritize future development efforts.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with software developers, content authors, validation engineers, and global engineering teams.

- Communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Support continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and evidence-based decision making.

- Contribute to the development of best practices, analytical methodologies, and reporting capabilities.
jobs.requirements_raw:
