- Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Automotive Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field preferred.

- Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.

Technical Skills

- Basic knowledge of SQL, relational databases, data analysis tools, or similar technologies.

- Strong ability to analyze, organize, and interpret data to support decision making.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other analytical software tools.

- Experience with data visualization, reporting tools, or dashboard development is a plus.

- Familiarity with Python, Power BI, or similar analytical tools is a plus.

Automotive Knowledge

- Understanding of vehicle diagnostics, automotive systems, and repair processes.

- Ability to research and interpret OEM service information and technical documentation.

- Experience in automotive service, diagnostics, dealership operations, validation, or related automotive fields is a strong plus.

- Familiarity with ADAS, electronic vehicle systems, and modern vehicle architectures is beneficial.

Professional Attributes

- Strong analytical mindset and passion for problem solving.

- Curiosity and persistence in researching complex technical issues.

- Excellent critical thinking and root-cause analysis skills.

- Detail-oriented with a commitment to high-quality work.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Self-motivated learner with the ability to quickly acquire new technical knowledge.

- Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Additional Requirements

- Daily local travel required; valid driver's license required (company vehicle provided).

- ASE Certification is a plus but not required.

jobs.description:
At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: We grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Welcome to Bosch.

As a Lead Engineer , you will act as the thermal expert for next-generation electric axle systems, ensuring optimal thermal performance, efficiency and cost competitiveness across platform and customer projects. Working closely with international and cross-functional teams, you will drive the development of innovative thermal management solutions for eMobility applications and contribute to the success of future electric powertrain systems.

Your tasks:

► Acting as the thermal expert for eAxle systems, ensuring thermal performance and cost competitiveness throughout the product lifecycle

► Developing, evaluating and implementing thermal system concepts and solutions in collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams

► Performing system-level thermal simulations and predicting the thermal behavior of eAxle components and systems

► Planning, defining and executing thermal measurements, including result analysis, interpretation and validation activities

► Developing and continuously improving thermal simulation models while ensuring correlation between simulation and measurement data

► Serving as the main interface for thermal-related topics between electric machine, gearbox and power electronics domains, as well as internal and external stakeholders

► Supporting project teams by taking ownership of thermal system deliverables, including requirement analysis, technical presentations and customer communication

► Providing technical guidance on thermal management topics and supporting system-level decision-making

► Supporting software-related topics at system level, including thermal management functions, control strategies and calibration concepts

► Contributing to the continuous development of thermal engineering methodologies, tools and processes

► Experience with thermal management and cooling concepts in electrified powertrain applications

► Experience with system simulation tools such as AMESIM, Simscape, Simulink or similar platforms

► Proficiency in MATLAB and common engineering tools (e.g. DOORS, MS Office)

► Understanding of 3D FEA and CFD simulation methods and related tools (e.g. ANSYS, Fluent)

► Good understanding of automotive embedded software architecture and system interactions

► Ability to formulate software-related requirements and understand software implementation from a system perspective

► Understanding of software-controlled thermal management strategies is an advantage

► Basic understanding of manufacturing and assembly processes as well as cost-efficient product design principles

► Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

► Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and global teams

► Fluent English language skills (written and spoken)

jobs.description:

日本の主要自動車メーカー（JOEM）向け次世代Digital Key Systemプロジェクトにおいて、顧客プロジェクトマネージャーとしてご活躍いただきます。

[募集背景]

事業拡大および新規プロジェクトの始動に伴い、体制をさらに強化するための増員募集です。

[ポジションの魅力・得られるスキル]

- 最先端のコネクテッドカー技術に携わることで、市場価値の高い高度なプロジェクトマネジメントスキルが身につきます。

- グローバルプロジェクトの推進を通じて、将来のキャリアステップに直結する大きな成長が期待できます。

- 多様な国籍のメンバーと協働することで、豊かな異文化間コミュニケーション能力やグローバルな視野を養うことができます。

- 海外拠点への出張機会（年1〜2回程度）もあり、グローバルに活躍している実感を強く得られる環境です。

[期待される役割]

- お客様と密接な関係を構築し、ニーズを的確に捉えながらプロジェクトを正しい方向へと導くリーダーシップが期待されます。

- 決められた予算とスケジュールの中で、プロジェクトを確実に成功へと導いていただくことを期待しています。

[チーム構成]

- 国籍、年齢、性別、バックグラウンドが多様で、お互いを尊重し合うダイバーシティに富んだチームです。

- PMO（プロジェクトマネジメントオフィス）に関するトップレベルの知見を持つスペシャリストが多数在籍しています。

- ヨーロッパや北米など、他地域の経験豊富なプロジェクトマネージャーからもしっかりとしたサポートを受けられる体制が整っています。

[チームの雰囲気・特徴]

- 年齢や役職の垣根がなく、意見交換が非常に活発なオープンでフラットな雰囲気です。

- 新しい技術や知識の習得、スキルアップに対して非常に高い意欲を持っているチームです。

- グローバルなプロジェクトマネジメント（PjM）コミュニティが存在し、困ったときにはいつでも国境を越えて助け合う温かい風土があります

jobs.description:
Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the chance to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Controls Engineer with a strong background in industrial automation and a deep expertise in CoDeSys for PLC programming. The successful candidate will play a critical role in the design, development, implementation, and commissioning of complex control systems for our [products/systems/manufacturing processes]. This role requires a hands-on approach, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to lead technical initiatives while mentoring junior engineers, all with a keen understanding of manufacturing principles and operational efficiency.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities:

System Design & Architecture:

- Lead the conceptualization, design, and specification of complex control systems, including hardware selection (PLCs, HMIs, drives, sensors, actuators) and network architecture.

- Develop detailed electrical schematics, I/O lists, and wiring diagrams in collaboration with electrical engineers.

- Define control strategies, safety interlocks, and operational sequences, always considering manufacturing process flow, cycle time optimization, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

CoDeSys Programming & Development (Core Responsibility):

- Expertly program, test, and debug PLC logic using CoDeSys (IEC 61131-3) in various languages (ST, FBD, LD, SFC).

- Develop and implement reusable CoDeSys libraries, function blocks, and structured text routines, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, and scalable for production environments.

- Integrate and configure various fieldbus protocols (e.g., EtherCAT, PROFINET, Modbus TCP/IP, CANopen) within the CoDeSys environment.

- Develop and integrate HMI/SCADA applications using CoDeSys visualization or other compatible platforms, prioritizing operator usability, process visibility, and diagnostic capabilities for manufacturing personnel.

Commissioning & Troubleshooting:

- Lead the on-site commissioning, testing, and tuning of control systems, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to specifications, with a focus on achieving production targets and minimizing downtime.

- Perform advanced troubleshooting and diagnostics of complex hardware and software issues, often under pressure in a live manufacturing environment.

- Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and software engineers to resolve system integration challenges, understanding their impact on the manufacturing line

•Documentation & Standards:

- Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including functional specifications, design documents, test plans, and as-built drawings, which are essential for long-term manufacturing support and maintenance.

- Ensure all control system designs and implementations comply with relevant industry standards (e.g., UL, CE, NFPA, ISO, ANSI) and manufacturing specific regulations.

- Adhere to established coding standards and best practices for CoDeSys development.

Project Leadership & Mentorship:

- Lead technical aspects of projects, including scope definition, scheduling, and resource allocation, considering production timelines and resource availability within a manufacturing context.

- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior controls engineers, fostering their development in CoDeSys and control system design with an emphasis on practical manufacturing applications.

- Participate in design reviews and provide constructive feedback.

Continuous Improvement & Manufacturing Optimization:

- Stay abreast of new technologies, industry trends, and best practices in industrial automation and CoDeSys, specifically those applicable to improving manufacturing processes and efficiency.

- Proactively identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, cost reduction
jobs.requirements_raw:
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline from an accredited university. Master's degree a plus.

• Experience: Minimum of 7+ years of progressive experience in industrial control systems design, programming, and commissioning, with a significant portion in manufacturing or production environments.

• Minimum of 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience programming and developing complex applications with CoDeSys (all versions/compatible platforms are valuable) for industrial machinery or production lines.

• Proven experience leading technical aspects of control system projects, from concept to production readiness.\

• Technical Skills (Must-Haves): Expert-level proficiency in CoDeSys (IEC 61131-3) programming.

• Strong understanding of industrial networking protocols (e.g., EtherCAT, PROFINET, Modbus TCP/IP, CANopen, Ethernet/IP).

• Proficient with HMI/SCADA development and integration, with an emphasis on intuitive operator interfaces and robust data acquisition for manufacturing analytics.

• Solid understanding of electrical control panel design principles and safety standards (e.g., NFPA 79, UL 508A, EN ISO 13489, IEC 60204), and their application in a manufacturing plant.

• Experience with industrial safety systems (e.g., safety PLCs, light curtains, emergency stops) as applied to production equipment and personnel safety.

• Familiarity with CAD software for electrical design (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN).

• Ability to read and interpret complex electrical schematics and mechanical drawings.

• Demonstrated understanding of manufacturing processes, including but not limited to: material handling, assembly, machining, packaging, process control, and quality inspection.

• Knowledge of key manufacturing metrics such as OEE, cycle time, throughput, and their impact on control system design.

• Soft Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, particularly in diagnosing and resolving production issues.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to convey complex technical information to production, maintenance, and management teams.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, including collaboration with production operators and maintenance technicians.

• Demonstrated leadership potential and ability to mentor.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

jobs.description:
一、岗位概述

负责智能驾驶 AI 模型训练全流程数据运营管理，覆盖场景数据挖掘及筛选、标注生产、质量管控，统筹项目需求管理、排期计划、成本管控、供应商团队管理，深度对接算法、平台开发团队，驱动预标注模型迭代优化，提升数据产能、标注精度、模型训练效果，支撑智驾算法迭代落地。

二、岗位职责

1、智驾数据生产全流程运营管理

1. 负责自动驾驶（感知 / 定位 / 预测 / 规控）训练数据的场景挖掘及筛选、标注生成，质量管控及交付

2. 统筹标注产线全流程管理：任务拆解、批次生产、进度跟进、问题沉淀

3. 建立标注质检体系，参与验收标准制定、抽检规则、错漏闭环机制，持续提升标注精度、合格率、有效样本率；

2、需求管理与项目计划管理

1. 承接算法迭代数据需求，拆解需求规格、输出数据方案、评估数据量、制定生产排期；

2. 负责跨部门需求对齐、需求澄清、版本管控、变更管理，保障数据交付准时、高质量；

3. 制定周 / 月度数据生产计划、产能规划、交付节奏管控，跟进交付进度、风险预警与问题闭环。

3、成本管理与效能优化

1. 负责数据标注生产成本核算、单价管控、产能核算、人效分析；

2. 持续优化生产链路，降低无效成本、提升有效数据产出比；

3. 输出月度数据运营报表：产能、质量、成本、问题复盘、迭代收益。

4、供应商团队管理

1. 管理外部标注供应商团队，负责供应商准入、产能调度、质量考核、绩效评级、问题追责；

2. 建立供应商 SOP 作业规范、培训体系、奖惩机制，稳定外部交付质量与产能；

3. 对接供应商日常问题答疑、难点攻坚、批量错漏复盘、流程优化。

5、平台对接与预标注模型优化

1. 深度对接内部数据平台、标注平台开发团队，反馈产线真实痛点；

2. 参与预标注模型、辅助标注工具、自动化质检模型的需求提报、测试验收、上线落地；

3. 通过模型迭代降低人工标注量、提升标注效率、降低错漏率，推动数据生产自动化提效。

6、体系沉淀与流程标准化

1. 沉淀数据生产 SOP、质检规范、场景筛选标准、问题分类库；

2. 持续复盘产线瓶颈，输出优化方案，迭代运营管理制度。
jobs.requirements_raw:
三、任职要求

1. 2 年以上智能驾驶数据运营 / 标注项目管理经验，熟悉智驾感知数据生产全流程，有成熟产线运营经验者优先；

2. 精通车道线、障碍物、语义、分割、轨迹等常规智驾标注业务，熟悉标注痛点、常见错漏、验收标准；

3. 具备需求拆解、项目排期、成本核算、产能管控能力，能够独立操盘完整数据项目；

4. 有供应商管理经验，懂外包团队考核、绩效、产能调度、质量风控；

5. 有对接平台开发、参与预标注模型优化经验优先，懂 AI 数据提效逻辑；

6. 逻辑清晰、数据敏感度高，擅长复盘、沉淀、流程优化，抗压能力强；

7. 熟练使用 Excel / 飞书多维表格等做数据统计、台账管理、进度管控；

8. 本科及以上学历，计算机、车辆工程、数据分析相关专业优先。

四、岗位加分项

1. 有主机厂 / 自动驾驶大厂数据运营、产线管理经验；

2. 有 Corner Case 挖掘、难样本专项迭代经验；

3. 有搭建过质检体系、抽验规则、绩效制度、成本核算模型经验；

4. 熟悉自动化标注、模型预标注、数据平台迭代逻辑。

五、岗位核心价值

管数据、管质量、管进度、管成本、管供应商、管模型迭代，是智驾算法迭代的核心支撑岗位，可独立负责整条数据产线的运营优化与提效落地。

Bosch Management Consulting (BMC/IC) is the internal management consultancy of the Bosch Group. Our consulting teams support senior management within the Bosch Group on strategic, organizational, and operational topics and help improve the business performance of our customers substantially and sustainably.

Do you want to contribute ideas that will shape the future of mobility? As one of the world’s largest automotive suppliers, Bosch is driving change in the mobility sector. Join us and you can help innovate, create, and form the future of mobility.

This position is responsible for technical project management of commercial vehicle steering systems, including electrohydraulic and fully electric steering systems. The role requires the ability to work independently, manage technical priorities, and collaborate across mechatronic product-development activities. The individual will work with a multidisciplinary development team—including systems, mechanical design, software, hardware, application and calibration, functional safety, cybersecurity, and project management professionals—to develop project-specific solutions for conventional, driver-assistance, automated-driving, and autonomous-vehicle applications.

The System Project Lead (SysPL) serves as the technical lead and technical counterpart to the Program Manager for the customer project. The SysPL is responsible for project-level technical integration and execution, coordinating across engineering disciplines to ensure that steering-system requirements are understood, aligned, validated, and completed within established project timelines.

- Evaluate and align customer requirements across relevant engineering domains, including System, Software, Hardware, Functional Safety, Cybersecurity, and other technical disciplines, engaging domain experts as needed.

- Coordinate technical activities across engineering domains to ensure an integrated steering system solution that meets customer and project requirements.

- Support translation of customer requirements into system requirements and ensure appropriate requirements management and traceability using applicable requirements management tools.

- Conduct system-level impact analysis for requirements and design changes and ensure appropriate validation is defined and completed.

- Establish and maintain customer relationships as the technical project lead and primary engineering interface for assigned customer project(s).

- Lead technical discussions with customers regarding steering system requirements, interfaces, performance, diagnostics, application, and system behavior.

- Drive resolution of cross-functional technical issues, risks, and open points, ensuring clear ownership and timely closure.

- Provide technical troubleshooting and coordinate appropriate engineering resources to resolve customer and system-level issues.

- Ensure system development, validation, and delivery are performed according to applicable guidelines and processes (e.g., ISO 26262, ASPICE, IATF 16949, and applicable cybersecurity processes).

- Lead the system-level release process, including assessment and documentation of system release for specified use cases with or without defined constraints, ensuring required validation evidence, open-point evaluation, and approvals are completed and documented.

- Plan, schedule, and execute demonstration vehicle builds and retrofits, coordinating across mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, software, and calibration teams to integrate steering systems into customer and prototype vehicle platforms.

- Monitor, track, and drive completion of technical open points for system-level topics.

- Support creation and implementation of the System FMEA and other system-level risk analyses, including review of Safety Failure Tree Analyses (FTAs) and Software Design Failure Analyses (DFAs), as applicable.

- Assist in the creation and review of the technical safety concept and support system-level functional safety activities.

- Create and release Technical Customer Documentation (TCD) and other required system-level technical documentation.

- Plan and report project engineering, development, and testing budgets and costs.

- Report project technical status, risks, open points, and budget status to management and relevant project stakeholders on a regular basis.

- Support continuous improvement and cost-reduction efforts throughout the project lifecycle.

- Lead and coordinate steering system development activities for conventional applications as well as driver assistance, automated driving, and autonomous vehicle applications.

- Coordinate and promote collaboration with global development locations, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders to achieve project goals.

- Travel approximately 15–20%, domestic and international, to customer, Bosch, and supplier locations as required.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Required Qualifications

- 5 or more years of professional experience in automotive and/or commercial vehicle product development, systems engineering, or related technical roles.

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Demonstrated experience with vehicle and system test procedures, release processes, and validation activities in the automotive or related industry.

- Demonstrated experience with systems engineering methodologies and requirements engineering practices.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple technical priorities in an organized manner, with demonstrated analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

- Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to global development teams, management, and external customers.

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary and international teams.

- Knowledge of the automotive product development lifecycle and associated processes.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in Mechatronics, Automotive Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Experience with commercial vehicle steering systems and/or other safety-critical vehicle systems.

- Working knowledge of hydraulic, electrohydraulic, and/or electric steering system technologies.

- Experience with driver assistance, automated driving, or autonomous vehicle development programs.

- Experience with functional safety and safety-critical product development, including ISO 26262 standards.

- Knowledge of automotive cybersecurity concepts and applicable cybersecurity standards.

- Experience using requirements management tools such as DOORS or equivalent platforms.

- Experience coordinating technical development across System, Software, Hardware, Functional Safety, Cybersecurity, Mechanical, and other engineering disciplines.

- Experience negotiating and aligning technical requirements with customers and internal stakeholders.

- Demonstrated customer-facing experience and ability to establish credibility in technical leadership roles.

jobs.title: SENIOR ENGINEER – BATTERY SOFTWARE MANAGEMENT – AFFIRMATIVE ACTION POSITION FOR WOMEN - 35407
jobs.description:
Na Bosch, moldamos o futuro por meio das inovações tecnológicas de alta qualidade e de serviços que despertam entusiasmo e melhoram a vida das pessoas. Temos uma promessa sólida para nossos colaboradores: crescemos juntos, gostamos do nosso trabalho e inspiramos uns aos outros. Junte-se a nós e sinta a diferença.

As a Battery Simulation Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, validating, and applying

electrical and thermal models of battery cells, modules, and full packs. Your work will directly

support the development and integration of high-performance, safe, and reliable battery systems

across various applications. This role requires a strong foundation in battery fundamentals,

simulation techniques, high-voltage electrical circuits, and systems-level thinking. You will

respond to technical requests using established tools and methodologies while also contributing to

the development of new modeling approaches to address emerging challenges in battery safety and

performance.

The responsibilities in this position include, but are not limited to:

- Develop and implement physics-based and empirical models for simulating the electrical, thermal,

and degradation performance of lithium-ion battery systems.

- Conduct 1D simulation studies to evaluate battery behavior under various electrical, thermal, and

environmental conditions, including fast charging, thermal events, and aging.

- Analyze laboratory test data to extract model parameters, validate simulation results, and improve

model robustness.

- Perform sensitivity studies, scenario simulation, and model-based evaluations to support design

and engineering decisions.

- Collaborate closely with cell, module, and pack design engineers, as well as test and control

teams, to define requirements and optimize system performance.

- Prepare technical documentation, reports, and presentations summarizing modeling methodology and

simulation outcomes.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams and share progress and insights with

stakeholders.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering,

Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Applied Physics from an ABET-accredited university.

- Minimum of 2 years of experience using simulation tools for engineering applications.

- Hands-on experience with 0D/1D battery simulation and analysis tools such as GT-SUITE,

MATLAB/Simulink, Amesim, or equivalent.

- Strong Understanding of lithium-ion battery fundamentals, including battery performance

characteristics, thermal characteristics, and aging mechanisms.

- Fundamental understanding of HV electrical circuits, busbar design, and Battery Disconnect Unit

(BDU) functionality within a battery system.

- Ability to analyze data, interpret results, and communicate findings clearly.

- Experience with optimization methods (DOE, parameter estimation, control optimization).

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly present

technical findings to cross-functional teams.

- Proven teamwork, interpersonal skills, and the ability to solve complex technical problems using

analytical and simulation-based approaches.

Preferred qualifications:

- Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering with a focus on

battery systems, electrochemistry, or thermal management.

- Hands-on experience with battery testing methods, aging studies, and performance evaluation.

- Proficiency in developing and applying 0D/1D/3D simulation models for battery systems.

- Background in embedded controls, Kalman filters, or estimator design for SOC/SOH/SOP.

- Good overall knowledge of battery performance and thermal management.

- Good skills in programming with commercial software (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python, Visual C++).

The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, Energy and Building Technology.

In India, the Group operates through nine companies with a combined strength of over 30,000 associates which includes around 14,000 research and development associates.

Bosch Automotive Electronics India Pvt. Ltd. (RBAI) is a 100% subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH. RBAI was established at the right time to cater to the demands of future Indian market. Established in 2009, started out with manufacturing Electronic Control Units. On an average adding one new product every year, Antenna and Immobilizer in 2011, wide range of BCM's since 2012, Electronic power steering control units from 2013, and Voltage regulator in 2014. Over the last 7 years of its existence, the company has grown over 44% CAGR, which is remarkable considering it was established during the peak of recession.

The product portfolio of Bosch Automotive Electronics Pvt. Ltd. is into both Automotive and Non-Automotive Business catering to local as well as global demands. The products from RBAI fulfils 94% of the local demand. Apart from this, 72% of our sales are towards exports covering most of the global market.

We invite promising and dynamic professionals for a long-term and

rewarding career with Bosch.

Key activities

1.Plan and execute the production planing for manufacturing by ensuring that the volumes are inline ith the available capacity and parts are released for production considering raw material coverage and engineering change requests.

2.Ensure on time delivery of parts as per customer schedule with right quantity and at right time.

3.Monitoring Plan Vs Actual to meet customer demand on time and support to achieve the Production KPI's.

4.Coordinate with the project planning teams to block the engineering change request as per the capacity allocated to meet the business requirements.

5.Calculate the supermarket stocks for every leveling period and monitor and maintain stock at warehouses as per the defined norms to ensure healthy inventory levels.

6.Escalate the deviations w.r.t production planning processes and procedures to management team (as per escalation matrix) to seek appropriate interventions / decisions.

7.Act as the point of escalation for Production planning topics and material coverage topics and ensuring timely resolution, communication and close looping as per the timeline.

8.Co ordinating with various departments (customer order planning,capacity planning, product planning, raw material planning and technical functions) to ensure smooth production as per the Bosch Production Systems.

jobs.title: Praktikum in der Entwicklung von Festoxid-Zellen (w/m/div.)
jobs.description:
Bei Bosch gestalten wir die Zukunft, indem wir hochwertige Technologien und Dienstleistungen entwickeln, die begeistern und das Leben der Menschen bereichern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeitenden ist felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, wir haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und wir inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Machen Sie mit und spüren Sie den Unterschied. Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Eine zentrale Herausforderung auf dem Weg zur Klimaneutralität ist die Speicherung von Strom aus erneuerbaren Quellen, beispielsweise in Form von Wasserstoff. Der Betrieb der Festoxid-Zelle (SOC) im Elektrolysemodus als Festoxid-Elektrolysezelle (SOEC) ermöglicht die direkte Umwandlung elektrischer Energie in chemische Energie. Aufgrund ihrer Betriebstemperatur von 600 °C und darüber weist die SOEC die höchste elektrische Effizienz unter den Elektrolysetechnologien auf und ist damit eine sehr vielversprechende Technologie für die Wasserstoffwirtschaft der Zukunft. Um unser Verständnis der während des SOEC-Betriebs ablaufenden Prozesse zu verbessern, werden die Zellen experimentell charakterisiert, um ihre Leistungsfähigkeit zu bestimmen und Daten zur Parametrisierung oder Validierung physikalischer Modelle bereitzustellen, die die Zellleistung oder Alterung vorhersagen.

Während Ihres Praktikums werden Sie SOEC-Einzelzellen experimentell mithilfe elektrochemischer Methoden charakterisieren, beispielsweise mittels elektrochemischer Impedanzspektroskopie sowie Strom-Spannungs-Kennlinien. Sie unterstützen die Inbetriebnahme eines neuen Prüfstands, einschließlich der Erstinbetriebnahme – von Software- bis zu Hardwarekomponenten – einschließlich hochpräziser Messgeräte. Nicht zuletzt werten Sie experimentelle Daten aus und präsentieren die Ergebnisse einem interdisziplinären Team.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Ausbildung: Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder Chemieingenieurwesen, Chemie, Physik, Materialwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit sehr guten Leistungen

- Erfahrung und Kenntnisse: Erste Laborerfahrung

- Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: Sie sind ein/e teamorientierte/r Mitarbeiter/in, der/die sich gut auf neue Herausforderungen einstellt; Sie bringen Leidenschaft für Ihre Aufgaben mit, arbeiten selbstständig und verfolgen Ziele konsequent, indem Sie Ihre Tätigkeiten systematisch planen

- Sprachen: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse

jobs.description:

Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Willkommen bei Bosch.

Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Die Zukunft nachhaltiger Kunststoffbauteile liegt in Ihren Händen. Sind Sie bereit, die Grenzen der Materialwissenschaft neu zu definieren und mit Ihrer Forschung einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Ressourceneffizienz zu leisten? Im Rahmen Ihrer Promotion erforschen Sie das thermomechanische Verhalten von Kunststoffen und schaffen die wissenschaftliche Grundlage für innovative Anwendungen von morgen.

- Zudem untersuchen Sie maßgebliche Deformations- und Versagensmechanismen, leiten Anforderungen an kontinuumsmechanische Materialmodelle ab und entwickeln diese aktiv weiter.

- Ihre Forschungsergebnisse bilden die Grundlage für präzisere Simulationen und ermöglichen einen gezielteren, sichereren sowie ressourcenschonenderen Einsatz von kurzglasfaserverstärkten Kunststoffen und deren Rezyklaten in technischen Komponenten.

jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

BGSV currently operates from three offices located at the following addresses:

1. Etown Building – 364 Cong Hoa Street, Ward 13, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

2. OfficeHaus Building – 32 Tan Thang Street, Son Ky Ward, Tan Phu District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

3. Capital Place Building – 29 Lieu Giai Street, Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, Vietnam

Application Period: 26 Sep 2026 to 14 Oct 2026

Interview date: 05, 13 & 15 Oct 2026

Onboarding date: 16 Oct 2026 & 2 Nov 2026

As a Fresher Embedded Software Engineer, you will have the opportunity to:

- Analyze and clarify software requirements.

- Develop, integrate, and test embedded software based on defined requirements.

- Support low-level and high-level software design for embedded modules.

- Perform software integration and test execution.

- Document development and test results.

- Analyze and debug software issues when required.

- Collaborate with experienced engineers and global development teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who can apply:

- Fresh graduates with a background in Electronics, Telecommunications, Mechatronics, Automation, Computer Engineering, or related fields.

Technical Skills:

- Good knowledge of C/C++ programming.

- Basic understanding of microcontrollers and embedded systems.

- Knowledge of Python, Perl, or other scripting languages is a plus.

- Basic knowledge of communication protocols and/or sensors is an advantage.

Other Skills:

- Good problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Willingness to learn and develop technical expertise in the automotive domain.

- Able to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing.

The Bosch Research and Technology Center North America with offices in Sunnyvale, California, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and Cambridge, Massachusetts is a part of the global Bosch Group (www.bosch.com), a company with over 70 billion euro revenue, 400,000 employees worldwide, a very diverse product portfolio, and a history spanning over 125 years. As a part of the global research, our AI research in Silicon Valley focuses on Foundation Models, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision & Mixed Reality, Cloud Robotics, Big Data Visual Analytics, Explainable AI (XAI), Data Science, AI System Engineering, Time-series Analysis. We develop scalable, intelligent, and trustworthy AIoT solutions for Bosch products and services in application areas such as automated driving, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), robotics, smart manufacturing, enterprise AI, health care, smart home and building solutions.

Originating from the AI research in Silicon Valley, our Foundation Model Powered AI Enablers group plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of industrial AI experiences for Bosch products and services. Our award-winning team (IEEE VIS best paper & best paper runner-ups) actively collaborates with leading academic and industry groups to advance research ideas and disseminate findings in top AI conferences and journals, such as CVPR, ICCV, ICRA, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, TVCG.

jobs.title: [ETA] Senior AUTOSAR Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

Welcome to the ETA Department

The ETA team specializes in the AUTOSAR Basic Software (BSW) platform, working closely with ETAS the global leader in automotive embedded systems tools. This collaboration gives us a strong edge in delivering high-quality, scalable software solutions.

As part of ETA regional teams, you’ll have the opportunity to implement platform components and work directly with clients, gaining hands-on experience in both development and communication.

Learn more about our work here.

Responsibilities:

- Be able to integrate MCAL, BSW, RTE and SWCs in projects which are based on AUTOSAR Classic Platform /or develop Flash Bootloader on specific targets

- Work directly with German/ Chinese / Korean/ Japanese customers

- Understand and analyze customer's requirements

- Software development, integration and testing based on requirements

- Execute software development tasks, document user guides, test results and report problems

- Handling tickets of new features, issues and change requests for the software platform

- Debug and maintain the software running on target devices (Real ECU and Virtual ECU) via network TCP/IP or Automotive protocols

- Provide effort estimation and other inputs for project planning

- Have several chances to travel to customer sites for business purpose

- Mentoring junior team members

- Technologies used: AUTOSAR (Com, Mem, Diag, Sys...), CAN/LIN/ETH, OSEK, RTOS, Cyber Security SW/HW w/ HSM, FBL, OTA, SOTA, Rollback, Self-Update SW Software Signature and SecureBoot.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Educational background

- Major in Computer Engineering/ Electrical-Electronics/ Telecommunication/ Mechatronics Engineering or equivalent.

Technical skills

- 3-6 years of experience in embedded software development

- Good knowledge of micro-controller, processor and embedded system

- Have experience in bare metal programming in embedded systems (C programming skills)

- Have experience in Embedded software development (C/C++ programming skills).

- Design methodology using OOAD, UML and design patterns

- Automotive communication protocols know-how, e.g. Ethernet/SOMEIP/CAN/ LIN/ Flexray and Classic AUTOSAR architecture & methodology should be advantages.

- Experience in Software Development Life-cycle

- Exposure to emulators, simulators, debugging and test equipment

- Exposure to Real Time Operating System (RTOS)

- It'd be a big advantage if you have experience in Flash bootloader development

Soft-skills and language skills

- Good communication skills, able to interact professionally with a diverse group of clients and staffs

- Good analytical skills

- Be able to work independently or with minimum supervision

- Good English communication skills.

Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the chance to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch.

Robert Boch (Pty) Ltd is seeking a Work Integrated Learner to join our Finance department based in our Midrand offices. This learnership programme is designed for TVET students pursuing a National Diploma in Finance who require workplace experience to complete their qualification.

This 18-month program is designed to provide you with hands-on experience and practical skills in a dynamic corporate environment. You will have the chance to apply your academic knowledge, learn from industry experts, and build a solid foundation for a successful career.

This opportunity could offer you:

- Valuable Work Experience: Gain practical, on-the-job training within a leading global organization.

- Professional Growth: Develop your skills and understanding of the finance sector.

- Monthly Stipend: Receive a consistent stipend throughout the duration of the program.

If you are a motivated and dedicated student ready to take the next step in your professional journey, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

This position will be contracted through Bosch’s external vendor under a one-year agreement.

Bosch Cross-Domain Computing & ADAS (XC-CP) Team develops high-quality, state-of-the-art Automotive Head Unit and Home Appliance Linux/Android-based systems.

Together with other Bosch locations worldwide, we provide software solutions for navigation, vehicle functions, autonomous driving, camera, and IoT features to the car marker. Our team also contributes to Bosch smart home & IoT solutions through SW delivery to Home Appliance products.

We are looking for talented NEO Vehicle Autosar Embedded SW Engineers with 2 to 5 years of experience to join our development team.

Key Responsible:

- Collaborate with third-party vendors (e.g., Vector, EB, MCAL) to incorporate any third-party software

- Create and maintain technical specification of components. If necessary, work in close collaboration with architects, function developers, product owner and other stakeholders to clarify and understand requirements

- You design and develop system- and hardware-related software components in C in compliance with current guidelines and standards, carry out analyses and reviews as well as the implementation of fully automation.

jobs.description:
The Bosch Group has more than 400 000 employees around the world, present in 60 countries, and we are proud to impact people’s lives and to work towards a more sustainable future.

Bosch Car Multimedia, S.A. belongs to the Automotive Electronics division and is focused on making the vehicles our third living space. The company' success lies in its highly specialized and innovative team, and on the technological know-how which makes Bosch the leading supplier in the automotive market.

At the Bosch Research & Development Center in Braga, more than 350 engineers develop car multimedia solutions and the most innovative localization, perception and safety sensors that are helping to shape connected and autonomous mobility. From hardware to software to physics, we have all kinds of opportunities waiting for you.

At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference in mindsets, cultures, generations, identities and perspectives. Everyone should bring their authenticity and work together respectfully. Bosch is an employer that values diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process and in the performance of professional activity. By including everyone and ensuring equal opportunities we unleash our full potential.

As a GenAI Engineer, you design, prototype, and implement AI agents that support engineering workflows across Bosch. You translate complex engineering use cases into intelligent, reliable, and compliant GenAI solutions that accelerate innovation.

Your contribution to something big:

- Designing and implementing GenAI agents that support engineering tasks such as requirements analysis, documentation assistance, test interpretation, and failure analysis.

- Building AI pipelines using LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and domain‑specific knowledge sources.

- Integrating AI agents with engineering tools, databases, and repositories (e.g., PLM systems, test data platforms, document repositories).

- Developing Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for structured and semi‑structured engineering data.

- Ensuring agent reliability, traceability, and safe behavior in regulated engineering environments.

- Collaborating with domain experts to evaluate usability, performance, and fit for purpose.

- Documenting architectures, APIs, integration points, and operational guidelines.

- Working closely with security and compliance teams to ensure responsible and compliant AI usage.
jobs.requirements_raw:

Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a comparable field.

Experience:

- Experience in GenAI development, agent orchestration, or AI‑assisted tooling.

- Solid software engineering background (Python preferred; experience with APIs and microservices).

- Familiarity with structured and semi‑structured data formats (JSON, PDFs, engineering documentation, etc.).

Know‑how:

- Understanding of LLM integration patterns, embeddings, and vector stores.

- Knowledge of agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Swarm, MCP).

- Nice to have: experience with MLOps, AI observability, evaluation frameworks, or model deployment.

- Nice to have: familiarity with PLM systems, engineering workflows, or compliance standards in automotive/industrial environments.

Working Style & Methods:

- Structured, reliable, and solution‑oriented working style.

- Ability to collaborate with cross‑functional engineering teams.

- Comfortable working in iterative, experimental environments.

Personality:

- Curious, proactive, and eager to explore new technologies.

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

- Open to learning and working with diverse teams and perspectives.

Languages: Proficient in English.

jobs.title: [EPC] Senior Test Engineer (Embedded Automotive Testing)
jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

BGSV currently operates from three offices located at the following addresses:

1. Etown Building – 364 Cong Hoa Street, Ward 13, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

2. OfficeHaus Building – 32 Tan Thang Street, Son Ky Ward, Tan Phu District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

3. Capital Place Building – 29 Lieu Giai Street, Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, Vietnam

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in defining, implementing and improving testing solutions for automotive embedded software products. The position combines technical leadership, test strategy development, automation enablement and cross-functional coordination to ensure delivery quality for complex vehicle communication and embedded system projects.

You will work closely with SWSD, Function Developers, Architects, Project Managers and global stakeholders to establish efficient testing approaches across SIL, HIL and Continuous Testing environments while driving competency growth and quality excellence within the team. Inspired by current EPC ComTest and SIL transformation initiatives. (VW & STLA Account)

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Quality Leadership

- Define and maintain project test strategy aligned with project requirements and organizational quality standards.

- Plan and coordinate testing activities across System Test, Software Qualification Test, SIL and HIL environments.

- Ensure requirement-to-test traceability and coverage throughout the development lifecycle.

- Review test specifications, test designs and test reports to ensure completeness and effectiveness.

- Drive quality improvement initiatives, defect prevention and lesson-learned activities.

Test Design & Execution

- Analyze requirements and clarify ambiguities with stakeholders.

- Develop test cases, test specifications and test data for embedded software systems.

- Automation & Continuous Testing

- Develop and enhance automated testing solutions using Python or similar scripting languages.

- Contribute to Continuous Testing (CT) and CI/CD integration for test execution.

- Improve testing efficiency through automation, reusable test assets and tooling.

- Support SIL-based validation and early defect detection strategies.

- Drive test environment optimization and automation initiatives.

Technical Leadership

- Mentor junior engineers and support competency development within the team.

- Provide technical guidance on test methodologies, automotive communication and debugging.

- Support onboarding, knowledge sharing and test process improvement initiatives.

- Act as technical focal point for testing-related topics within projects.

Stakeholder Management

- Collaborate with global teams, project managers, architects and customers.

- Report test progress, risks and quality status to internal and external stakeholders.

- Support audits, assessments and compliance activities (ASPICE, Functional Safety, Quality Gate Reviews).

- Execute and monitor system-level and software-level validation activities.

- Investigate defects, perform root-cause analysis and support issue resolution.

- Generate test summary reports and communicate project quality status.

Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary, subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.

Department Information

Bosch Cross-Domain Compute Enhance (XC-CE) Team is looking for full-time System Architect working at Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The XC-CE Team develops high-quality, state-of-the-art Vehicle Compute-ECU, Body-domain and Zone ECU, Perfectly Keyless, Vehicle Integration Platform and Central Gateway.

Job Description

The System Architect is responsible for defining, developing, and maintaining complex automotive embedded systems and system-of-systems throughout the product lifecycle.

The role requires deep understanding of customer use cases, stakeholder needs, system behavior, internal and external interfaces, and functional architectures. The System Architect acts as the technical owner of the system concept and ensures that requirements, architecture, interfaces, and verification strategies are complete, consistent, traceable, and aligned with customer expectations and industry standards.

Beyond individual contributions, the System Architect provides technical leadership across multiple engineering disciplines, including System, Software, Hardware, Integration, Verification & Validation, Security, and Functional Safety teams. The role drives technical decisions, supports customer discussions, and ensures successful execution of system engineering activities in compliance with ASPICE and Bosch development processes.

Main responsibilities

- System Requirements Engineering

- Elicit, analyze, negotiate, document, and manage stakeholder requirements.

- Translate customer and stakeholder needs into clear, complete, and testable system requirements.

- Ensure consistency, completeness, feasibility, and verifiability of requirements.

- Define acceptance criteria and verification strategies for system requirements.

- Establish and maintain end-to-end traceability between stakeholder requirements, system requirements, architecture elements, and verification artifacts.

- Conduct impact analysis for requirement changes and coordinate implementation across affected domains.

- Review, approve, baseline, and release system requirements.

- System Architecture & Design

- Define and maintain system architecture for complex embedded systems and system-of-systems.

- Analyze functional, logical, and technical interactions between software, hardware, communication networks, cloud services, mobile applications, and vehicle systems.

- Identify, specify, and maintain system interfaces and interaction models.

- Lead architectural trade-off studies considering performance, safety, security, cost, maintainability, and customer expectations.

- Ensure architectural consistency across all engineering disciplines.

- Support architectural decomposition into hardware, software, and verification work products.

- Technical Leadership & Coordination

- Serve as technical lead for system engineering topics within projects.

- Coordinate system engineering activities across multiple teams and disciplines.

- Guide and mentor System Engineers and junior team members.

- Drive technical alignment between stakeholders, project management, customers, and engineering teams.

- Facilitate technical reviews, workshops, architecture reviews, and requirement clarification sessions.

- Lead root-cause analysis and complex debugging activities involving Software, Hardware, V&V, Security, and System Integration teams

- Verification & Validation Support

- Define system-level verification approaches and success criteria.

- Ensure system requirements are fully testable and traceable to verification activities.

- Support creation and review of test strategies, test specifications, and validation plans.

- Analyze system verification results and drive corrective actions when deviations occur

- Process Compliance & Quality Assurance

- Take ownership of ASPICE SYS.1, SYS.2, SYS.3, and relevant lifecycle work products.

- Ensure compliance with Bosch development processes, customer-specific processes, and quality standards.

- Support project assessments, audits, and process improvement initiatives.

- Drive continuous improvement of system engineering methodologies, templates, and best practices

- Customer Technical Interface

- Coordinate team on System Engineering tasks.

- Lead and participate into debug session with other domains (Software, Test, Hardware, etc Act as a primary technical contact for system-level discussions with customers.

- Lead requirement clarification and technical alignment meetings.

- Support effort estimation, risk assessment, and change request evaluations.

- Present system concepts, technical solutions, and engineering decisions to customers and management.

Här ryms alla funktioner under ett tak: Från utveckling och produktion till försäljning och service. Hägglunds har cirka 600 medarbetare runtom i världen, varav cirka 400 jobbar i Mellansel.

Der Bereich Corporate Research ist das Herzstück unserer Innovation. Sie werden Teil des Bosch Research Computer Vision and AI Lab in Hildesheim, Deutschland, und arbeiten an vorderster Front an der Entwicklung der nächsten Generation autonomer Systeme. Wir suchen eine engagierte und kreative Doktorandin bzw. einen engagierten und kreativen Doktoranden, die bzw. der unser Team verstärkt und die Zukunft KI-gestützter Mobilität mitgestaltet.

Sie entwickeln ein generisches prädiktives Occupancy-Modell als zentrale Repräsentation der Fahrszene und entwerfen Architekturen, die Geometrie und Semantik aller Objekte erfassen, um ein explizites Verständnis der 4D-Dynamik der Welt zu ermöglichen. Darüber hinaus erforschen, implementieren und evaluieren Sie neuartige End-to-End-(E2E)-Fahrarchitekturen auf Basis prädiktiver Occupancy-Weltmodelle, um eine robuste Situationswahrnehmung und sichere Navigation zu gewährleisten. Sie entwickeln modernste Wahrnehmungssysteme, die Rohsensordaten nahtlos in aussagekräftige räumliche Repräsentationen und Fahraktionen überführen und so die Lücke zwischen Wahrnehmung und automatisiertem Fahren schließen.

Im Rahmen dieser Position erstellen Sie Architekturen, bei denen Fahrentscheidungen direkt auf prädiktiven Occupancy-Weltmodellen basieren, um räumlich fundierte und verlässliche Aktionen sicherzustellen. Nicht zuletzt testen Sie Ihre Modelle rigoros in Simulationen und mit Realweltdaten, weisen Verbesserungen in Sicherheit, Transparenz und Performance nach und veröffentlichen Ihre Ergebnisse auf führenden KI- und Robotik-Konferenzen.

We are looking for an Automotive Diagnostic Software Engineer (1-8 Years of Experience) to join our automotive engineering team. - Simulation of automotive systems using simulator solutions and in conjunction with OE testers.

- Design & creation of workflow or test sequences in Bosch standard tools

jobs.description:
HydraForce, a Bosch Rexroth company under the compact Hydraulics offers one of the most comprehensive lines of high-quality hydraulic cartridge valves for the mobile and industrial equipment markets. We design and manufacture high performance valves that meet virtually any need encountered in machine design. HydraForce cartridge valves are designed to fit a wide range of industry-common valve cavities. Our employees enjoy a fast-paced and challenging work environment that provides them with daily opportunities to Power Forward their careers. For almost 35 years, HydraForce has been producing the most innovative electro-hydraulic control solutions for the mobile machinery and industrial equipment markets.

Bosch Rexroth is one of the world’s leading providers of drive and control technologies. Regardless of the motion task that customers face anywhere in the world, they will always find a Bosch Rexroth team with the local experience and the appropriate know-how from more than 30 industries and all drive and control technologies. Our associates take on their customers’ challenges with passion and persistence until the right solution is found. This is what makes Bosch Rexroth a strong, reliable partner for Mobile Applications, Machinery Applications and Engineering and Factory Automation. As the Drive & Control Company, we develop, produce, and distribute our components and system solutions in over 80 countries.

As a Cycle Counter II, you will serve as a foundational member of the plant’s inventory control team, dedicated to ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our inventory. You are a detail-oriented and reliable professional responsible for the precise execution of daily cycle counts and the accurate entry of data into our SAP system.

Your primary mission is to provide the accurate, real-time data needed to help correct our significant inventory discrepancies. By diligently performing physical counts, verifying stock locations, and conducting initial variance checks, you will play a vital role in creating a reliable bridge between our physical warehouse and our financial records. This position is essential for establishing the discipline and accuracy required to meet Bosch’s global standards for operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

· Execute Daily Cycle Counts & Data Entry (70%):

o Execute daily, scheduled cycle counts of raw materials, work-in-progress (WIP), and finished goods according to SAP-generated count sheets and ABC classifications.

o Enter physical count data into SAP S/4HANA with a high degree of accuracy and timeliness to maintain system integrity.

o Verify that physical inventory locations match system records, and report any misplaced stock, labeling errors, or damaged materials to the Senior Cycle Counter.

o Ensure all materials are handled and stored properly according to company procedures.

· Perform First-Level Discrepancy Checks (20%):

o Perform immediate recount verifications when initial counts do not match system balances to confirm discrepancies.

o Conduct basic research for simple variances, such as checking adjacent storage bins or confirming unit of measure.

o Escalate all unresolved discrepancies to the Senior Cycle Counter for in-depth, second-level investigation.

o Assist the Senior Cycle Counter in gathering data for root-cause analysis as needed.

· Adhere to Process & Safety Standards (10%):

o Strictly adhere to all established inventory control policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and safety protocols.

o Maintain clean, organized, and clearly labeled inventory storage areas to facilitate efficient and safe counting processes.

o Proactively identify and suggest opportunities for improvement in count routes or basic processes to enhance efficiency.

jobs.description:
Bosch has been present in Malaysia since 1923, represented by Robert Bosch Sdn Bhd. In Malaysia, Bosch is active in four business sectors: Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. The company has three manufacturing sites and research and development offices in Penang, producing automotive electronics, power tools and steering systems, and soon a fourth plant with a final testing centre for sensors and semiconductors. In 2020, Bosch Malaysia generated consolidated sales of RM 518.4 million (108.1 million euros) and currently employs more than 4,000 associates.

PgP5 Plant is Bosch Group’s newest expansion in Malaysia a semiconductor test site in Batu Kawan Penang. The construction began in May 2021, and first series of production commenced in 2023. With the long-term forecasts for growth of semiconductor component quantities, coupled with the front-end production in Bosch’s Dresden facility in Germany, capacity expansion is required for the back-end production, which is the final testing phase of semiconductors and sensors. PgP5 will primarily focus on the final testing of components manufactured at Bosch Automotive Electronics’ fab in Dresden, Germany. The plant will also house R&D and training facilities.

Bosch in Malaysia is a part of the Bosch Group, a leading global supplier of technology and services. The Bosch Group’s strategic objective is to deliver innovations for a connected life. Bosch improves quality of life worldwide with products and services that are innovative and spark enthusiasm. In short, Bosch creates technology that is “Invented for life”.

We're looking for an experienced Manufacturing Project Lead to join our operations team in Batu Kawan, Malaysia. In this role, you drive strategic manufacturing initiatives and special projects supporting business growth, operational excellence, and transformation across PgP5. The role closely collaborates with Manufacturing (MST) and acts as a key interface to Manufacturing IT (MFI). Key Responsibilities

- Technical strategy and architecture: Define the front-end architecture (React + TypeScript primary) including state management patterns, choosing frameworks and patterns that ensure scalability and maintainability. Drive API contract discipline with backend and define caching/streaming strategies for real-time data.

- Design System Management: Own and scale the Bosch Digital Design System and component library, ensuring pixel-perfect consistency across all regions and product modules. You will ensure Bosch Corporate Design is applied correctly.

- Workflow Automation UX: Design and implement intuitive interfaces for complex logic, such as drag-and-drop workflow builders, real-time data dashboards, and integration of wizards.

- Design system leadership: Own and evolve the component library and design tokens (theming, dark/HC modes); govern adoption via Storybook, documentation, and CI gates (lint, a11y, visual regression). Ensure consistency and scalability across modules and international variants.

- Global readiness (i18n, a11y, performance): Ensure high performance across varying network conditions and localized support for multiple languages and regional data standards.

- Engineering excellence and security: Build a testing strategy and implement CI/CD quality gates, bundle analysis, and static checks.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with UX/UI designers to bridge the gap between high-fidelity designs and technical feasibility, and with backend teams to define robust API contracts.

- Team Mentorship: Mentor engineers, lead code reviews, establish engineering standards and playbooks, and contribute to hiring and onboarding

At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference in mindsets, cultures, generations, identities and perspectives. Everyone should bring their authenticity and work together respectfully. Bosch is an employer that values diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process and in the performance of professional activity. By including everyone and ensuring equal opportunities we unleash our full potential.

At Bosch eBike, we are revolutionizing the cycling experience with award-winning eBike systems and innovative features. We are seeking a passionate and skilled Software Developer to join our dynamic team and contribute to the development of automated test environments, validation frameworks, and engineering tools that ensure the quality and reliability of our cutting-edge eBike systems.

If you enjoy developing software solutions for embedded systems, designing automated test infrastructures, and solving complex technical challenges, this is your opportunity to contribute to a world-leading brand.

Your contribution to something big:

As a Software Developer (Python), you will play a crucial role in the development and maintenance of automated test environments and validation frameworks for Linux-based embedded software projects. You will enable fully automated testing of embedded systems in hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments and support the continuous improvement of software quality throughout the development lifecycle.

You will contribute to this goal by:

Test Environment Development & Automation

- Developing and maintaining Python-based test frameworks for Linux embedded software projects.

- Enabling fully automated testing of embedded software in Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) setups.

- Implementing automated execution of test cases, component resets, log collection, bug reporting, and consolidated test reporting.

- Developing automation solutions using Pytest and modern software engineering practices.

- Supporting continuous integration and continuous testing activities.

Software Design & Architecture

- Designing scalable, maintainable, and robust software architectures for test environments and engineering tools.

- Defining and implementing KPI measurements to monitor software quality, reliability, and testing efficiency.

- Creating reusable libraries, APIs, and services to support validation and testing activities across engineering teams.

- Contributing to the evolution of software architecture, coding standards, and development methodologies.

Embedded Systems Validation

- Supporting all software testing activities from requirements management through test specification, implementation, execution, reporting, and defect tracking.

- Analyzing CAN communication traces and system behavior to identify issues and improve product quality.

- Working closely with software, electronics, and system engineering teams to ensure complete validation coverage.

Tooling & Infrastructure

- Working with modern development and testing tools in a Linux environment.

- Utilizing Git, GitHub, Jira, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines to support efficient development and validation processes.

- Integrating and utilizing debugging and analysis tools such as Lauterbach and SEGGER interfaces.

- Supporting automation and infrastructure improvements for validation environments.

Documentation & Reporting

- Creating and maintaining technical documentation, including software architecture, test frameworks, operational procedures, and user guides.

- Producing clear, traceable test reports and ensuring transparency of testing results.

- Supporting knowledge sharing and continuous process improvement within the team.

As Thermal System Engineer for eMachine & eAxle, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing thermal system concepts that ensure the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of electric powertrain systems. You will combine simulation, testing, and cross-functional collaboration while working closely with experts from electric machine, gearbox, power electronics, and software domains to support the successful development and validation of eMobility solutions.

Your Tasks

- Act as a thermal system responsible for eMachine and eAxle, ensuring optimal thermal system performance and cost-competitiveness across platform and customer projects

- Develop & evaluate eMachine layouts and eAxle thermal system concepts in collaboration with cross-functional teams

- Perform system-level thermal simulations and predict thermal behavior of eAxle and eMachine components

- Plan, define, and conduct thermal measurements, including analysis and interpretation of results, support validation process

- Development & continuous improvement of thermal system simulation models. Ensure alignment between simulation and measurement data

- Serve as the main interface for thermal topics between key domains (electric machine, gearbox, power electronics) and towards internals/external stakeholders

- Support project teams as a core contributor, taking responsibility for thermal system related deliverables (e.g. requirement evaluation, customer communication, presentation of technical results towards the project, general support in thermal system related questions)

- Support software-related topics at system level, with basic understanding of control strategies, thermal management functions, and calibration logic

- Thermodynamics Expertise: Strong knowledge in thermodynamics, heat transfer, and thermal cause-and-effect relationships on both component and system level.

- System-Level Understanding of the overall functionality, requirements, and interdependencies of electric powertrain components, including vehicle-level interactions

- Good understanding of thermal system behaviour & cooling concepts in eMobility & powertrain applications

- Experience with system simulation tools such as AMESIM, Simscape, Simulink or similar

- Proficiency in MATLAB and general engineering tools (e.g. DOORS, MS Office)

- Understanding of 3D FEA & CFD simulation methods and corresponding tools (e.g. ANSYS, Fluent)

Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

Role Summary

Responsible for delivering end-to-end support for corporate credit card operations within the T2E function, including card management, transaction queries, and payment reconciliation. Acts as the primary point of contact for employees, providing policy guidance, resolving disputes, and supporting expense reporting processes. Ensures timely ticket resolution in line with SLAs while collaborating with Finance and Travel teams to drive efficient and compliant operations. Maintains accurate documentation and contributes to continuous process improvement

Key Responsibilities

-
Corporate Credit Card Support:

Provide end-to-end support for corporate credit card users, including card issuance, transaction inquiries, and cardholder limit clarifications.

-
Policy Guidance:

Interpret and communicate company-specific credit card policies to employees, ensuring adherence and resolving policy-related queries.

-
Payment Handling:

Assist with payment processing, reconciliation, and issue resolution related to corporate credit card transactions.

-
Financial Understanding:

Review and explain credit card statements, billing cycles, and transaction details. Handle chargebacks and disputed transactions effectively.

-
Internal Customer Support:

Act as the first point of contact for internal stakeholders regarding credit card and expense-related issues.

-
Ticket Management:

Prioritize and resolve support tickets using tools like ServiceNow or similar platforms, ensuring timely closure in line with SLAs.

-
Expense Reporting Assistance:

Guide employees on proper classification and submission of travel and business expenses through the company’s travel and expense platform.

-
Collaboration:

Work closely with Finance, Accounting, and Travel teams to ensure smooth operations and continuous improvement of credit card processes.

-
Documentation & Reporting:

Maintain accurate records of support activities and contribute to knowledge base articles and FAQs.
